# Warehouse schema snapshot.

# Generated by `python -m tests.support.schema_snapshot --write` from a
# bootstrapped warehouse. Do not hand-edit: regenerate, and review the
# diff. A change here is a schema change, and an unexplained one is the
# thing this file exists to surface.

r control.acs_ingestion_slices
    column id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('control.acs_ingestion_slices_id_seq'::regclass)
    column dataset text NOT NULL
    column year integer NOT NULL
    column geo_level text NOT NULL
    column state_fips text
    column variables_hash text
    column variables_count integer
    column status text NOT NULL
    column rows_loaded bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    column started_at timestamp with time zone
    column finished_at timestamp with time zone
    column variables_hash_seen_at timestamp with time zone
    column last_error text
    constraint acs_ingestion_slices_check CHECK (((finished_at IS NULL) OR ((started_at IS NOT NULL) AND (started_at <= finished_at))))
    constraint acs_ingestion_slices_check1 CHECK ((((geo_level = ANY (ARRAY['us'::text, 'state'::text])) AND (state_fips IS NULL)) OR ((geo_level = 'county'::text) AND (state_fips ~ '^[0-9]{2}$'::text))))
    constraint acs_ingestion_slices_dataset_check CHECK ((dataset = ANY (ARRAY['acs1'::text, 'acs5'::text])))
    constraint acs_ingestion_slices_geo_level_check CHECK ((geo_level = ANY (ARRAY['us'::text, 'state'::text, 'county'::text])))
    constraint acs_ingestion_slices_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
    constraint acs_ingestion_slices_rows_loaded_check CHECK ((rows_loaded >= 0))
    constraint acs_ingestion_slices_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['planned'::text, 'running'::text, 'success'::text, 'empty'::text, 'failed'::text])))
    constraint acs_ingestion_slices_year_check CHECK (((year >= 2000) AND ((year)::numeric <= (EXTRACT(year FROM CURRENT_DATE) + (1)::numeric))))
    index acs_ingestion_slices_hash_idx CREATE INDEX acs_ingestion_slices_hash_idx ON control.acs_ingestion_slices USING btree (variables_hash)
    index acs_ingestion_slices_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX acs_ingestion_slices_pkey ON control.acs_ingestion_slices USING btree (id)
    index acs_ingestion_slices_status_idx CREATE INDEX acs_ingestion_slices_status_idx ON control.acs_ingestion_slices USING btree (status)
    index acs_ingestion_slices_uniq_nostate CREATE UNIQUE INDEX acs_ingestion_slices_uniq_nostate ON control.acs_ingestion_slices USING btree (dataset, year, geo_level) WHERE (state_fips IS NULL)
    index acs_ingestion_slices_uniq_state CREATE UNIQUE INDEX acs_ingestion_slices_uniq_state ON control.acs_ingestion_slices USING btree (dataset, year, geo_level, state_fips) WHERE (state_fips IS NOT NULL)

r control.bls_ingestion_slices
    column id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('control.bls_ingestion_slices_id_seq'::regclass)
    column program text NOT NULL
    column year_start integer NOT NULL
    column year_end integer NOT NULL
    column geo_level text
    column state_fips text
    column series_hash text
    column series_count integer
    column status text NOT NULL
    column rows_loaded bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    column started_at timestamp with time zone
    column finished_at timestamp with time zone
    column series_hash_seen_at timestamp with time zone
    column last_error text
    constraint bls_ingestion_slices_check CHECK (((year_start >= 1900) AND (year_end >= year_start) AND ((year_end)::numeric <= (EXTRACT(year FROM CURRENT_DATE) + (1)::numeric))))
    constraint bls_ingestion_slices_check1 CHECK (((finished_at IS NULL) OR ((started_at IS NOT NULL) AND (started_at <= finished_at))))
    constraint bls_ingestion_slices_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
    constraint bls_ingestion_slices_rows_loaded_check CHECK ((rows_loaded >= 0))
    constraint bls_ingestion_slices_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['planned'::text, 'running'::text, 'success'::text, 'empty'::text, 'failed'::text])))
    index bls_ingestion_slices_geo_idx CREATE INDEX bls_ingestion_slices_geo_idx ON control.bls_ingestion_slices USING btree (geo_level)
    index bls_ingestion_slices_hash_idx CREATE INDEX bls_ingestion_slices_hash_idx ON control.bls_ingestion_slices USING btree (series_hash)
    index bls_ingestion_slices_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bls_ingestion_slices_pkey ON control.bls_ingestion_slices USING btree (id)
    index bls_ingestion_slices_state_idx CREATE INDEX bls_ingestion_slices_state_idx ON control.bls_ingestion_slices USING btree (state_fips)
    index bls_ingestion_slices_status_idx CREATE INDEX bls_ingestion_slices_status_idx ON control.bls_ingestion_slices USING btree (status)
    index bls_ingestion_slices_uniq CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bls_ingestion_slices_uniq ON control.bls_ingestion_slices USING btree (program, year_start, year_end, COALESCE(geo_level, ''::text), COALESCE(state_fips, ''::text))

r control.capture_quarantine
    column quarantine_id uuid NOT NULL
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_code text NOT NULL
    column parser_version text NOT NULL
    column error_code text NOT NULL
    column error_summary text NOT NULL
    column status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'::text
    column replay_attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    column last_replayed_at timestamp with time zone
    column resolved_at timestamp with time zone
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint capture_quarantine_capture_id_parser_version_error_code_key UNIQUE (capture_id, parser_version, error_code)
    constraint capture_quarantine_capture_id_run_id_source_code_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id, run_id, source_code) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id, run_id, source_code)
    constraint capture_quarantine_check CHECK (((status <> 'resolved'::text) OR (resolved_at IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint capture_quarantine_error_code_check CHECK ((btrim(error_code) <> ''::text))
    constraint capture_quarantine_error_summary_check CHECK ((btrim(error_summary) <> ''::text))
    constraint capture_quarantine_parser_version_check CHECK ((btrim(parser_version) <> ''::text))
    constraint capture_quarantine_pkey PRIMARY KEY (quarantine_id)
    constraint capture_quarantine_replay_attempts_check CHECK ((replay_attempts >= 0))
    constraint capture_quarantine_source_code_check CHECK ((source_code ~ '^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_-]*$'::text))
    constraint capture_quarantine_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'replaying'::text, 'resolved'::text, 'ignored'::text])))
    index capture_quarantine_capture_id_parser_version_error_code_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX capture_quarantine_capture_id_parser_version_error_code_key ON control.capture_quarantine USING btree (capture_id, parser_version, error_code)
    index capture_quarantine_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX capture_quarantine_pkey ON control.capture_quarantine USING btree (quarantine_id)
    index capture_quarantine_status_idx CREATE INDEX capture_quarantine_status_idx ON control.capture_quarantine USING btree (source_code, status, created_at)

v control.data_quality_latest_result
    column rule_id text
    column severity text
    column layer text
    column object_name text
    column source_code text
    column partition_key text
    column result text
    column observed_count bigint
    column expected_count bigint
    column observed_measure numeric
    column evidence jsonb
    column review_status text
    column evaluated_at timestamp with time zone
    column quality_run_id uuid
    column assessment_type text
    column code_commit_sha text
    column rule_set_version text
    body SELECT DISTINCT ON (result.rule_id, result.object_name, result.partition_key) result.rule_id,
    body     result.severity,
    body     result.layer,
    body     result.object_name,
    body     result.source_code,
    body     result.partition_key,
    body     result.result,
    body     result.observed_count,
    body     result.expected_count,
    body     result.observed_measure,
    body     result.evidence,
    body     result.review_status,
    body     result.evaluated_at,
    body     result.quality_run_id,
    body     run.assessment_type,
    body     run.code_commit_sha,
    body     run.rule_set_version
    body    FROM control.data_quality_result result
    body      JOIN control.data_quality_run run ON run.quality_run_id = result.quality_run_id
    body   ORDER BY result.rule_id, result.object_name, result.partition_key, result.evaluated_at DESC, result.result_id DESC;

r control.data_quality_result
    column result_id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('control.data_quality_result_result_id_seq'::regclass)
    column quality_run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column rule_id text NOT NULL
    column severity text NOT NULL
    column layer text NOT NULL
    column object_name text NOT NULL
    column source_code text NOT NULL
    column partition_key text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
    column partition_detail jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
    column result text NOT NULL
    column observed_count bigint
    column expected_count bigint
    column observed_measure numeric
    column source_watermark text
    column latest_capture_id uuid
    column evidence jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb
    column evaluated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column duration_ms integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    column review_status text
    constraint data_quality_result_duration_ms_check CHECK ((duration_ms >= 0))
    constraint data_quality_result_evidence_check CHECK ((pg_column_size(evidence) <= 8192))
    constraint data_quality_result_latest_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (latest_capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint data_quality_result_layer_check CHECK ((layer = ANY (ARRAY['raw'::text, 'control'::text, 'silver'::text, 'reference'::text, 'gold'::text, 'publisher'::text, 'serving'::text, 'glossary'::text])))
    constraint data_quality_result_object_name_check CHECK ((object_name ~ '^[a-z_]+\.[a-z_0-9]+$'::text))
    constraint data_quality_result_one_per_rule_object_partition UNIQUE (quality_run_id, rule_id, object_name, partition_key)
    constraint data_quality_result_pkey PRIMARY KEY (result_id)
    constraint data_quality_result_quality_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (quality_run_id) REFERENCES control.data_quality_run(quality_run_id)
    constraint data_quality_result_result_check CHECK ((result = ANY (ARRAY['pass'::text, 'fail'::text, 'warn'::text, 'not_applicable'::text])))
    constraint data_quality_result_review_is_for_warnings CHECK (((review_status IS NULL) OR (result = 'warn'::text)))
    constraint data_quality_result_review_status_check CHECK ((review_status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'acknowledged'::text, 'accepted'::text, 'escalated'::text])))
    constraint data_quality_result_rule_id_check CHECK ((rule_id ~ '^DQ-[A-Z]+-[0-9]{3}$'::text))
    constraint data_quality_result_severity_check CHECK ((severity = ANY (ARRAY['BLOCK'::text, 'QUARANTINE'::text, 'WARN'::text, 'INFO'::text])))
    constraint data_quality_result_source_code_check CHECK ((btrim(source_code) <> ''::text))
    index data_quality_result_one_per_rule_object_partition CREATE UNIQUE INDEX data_quality_result_one_per_rule_object_partition ON control.data_quality_result USING btree (quality_run_id, rule_id, object_name, partition_key)
    index data_quality_result_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX data_quality_result_pkey ON control.data_quality_result USING btree (result_id)
    index ix_data_quality_result_object CREATE INDEX ix_data_quality_result_object ON control.data_quality_result USING btree (object_name, evaluated_at DESC)
    index ix_data_quality_result_rule_evaluated CREATE INDEX ix_data_quality_result_rule_evaluated ON control.data_quality_result USING btree (rule_id, evaluated_at DESC)

r control.data_quality_run
    column quality_run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_code text NOT NULL
    column ingestion_run_id uuid
    column publication_event_id uuid
    column assessment_type text NOT NULL
    column code_commit_sha text NOT NULL
    column rule_set_version text NOT NULL
    column evaluated_scope jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
    column started_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column finished_at timestamp with time zone
    column overall_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running'::text
    column failure_summary text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
    constraint data_quality_run_assessment_type_check CHECK ((assessment_type = ANY (ARRAY['inline'::text, 'scheduled'::text, 'release'::text, 'manual'::text])))
    constraint data_quality_run_code_commit_sha_check CHECK ((code_commit_sha ~ '^[0-9a-f]{40}$'::text))
    constraint data_quality_run_failure_summary_check CHECK ((char_length(failure_summary) <= 2000))
    constraint data_quality_run_finished_after_start CHECK (((finished_at IS NULL) OR (finished_at >= started_at)))
    constraint data_quality_run_ingestion_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (ingestion_run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint data_quality_run_overall_status_check CHECK ((overall_status = ANY (ARRAY['running'::text, 'pass'::text, 'warn'::text, 'fail'::text, 'error'::text])))
    constraint data_quality_run_pkey PRIMARY KEY (quality_run_id)
    constraint data_quality_run_publication_event_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (publication_event_id) REFERENCES control.publisher_ready_event(event_id)
    constraint data_quality_run_rule_set_version_check CHECK ((btrim(rule_set_version) <> ''::text))
    constraint data_quality_run_source_code_check CHECK ((btrim(source_code) <> ''::text))
    constraint data_quality_run_terminal_has_finish CHECK (((overall_status = 'running'::text) OR (finished_at IS NOT NULL)))
    index data_quality_run_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX data_quality_run_pkey ON control.data_quality_run USING btree (quality_run_id)
    index ix_data_quality_run_source_started CREATE INDEX ix_data_quality_run_source_started ON control.data_quality_run USING btree (source_code, started_at DESC)

v control.data_quality_source_status
    column source_code text
    column quality_run_id uuid
    column assessment_type text
    column overall_status text
    column rule_set_version text
    column code_commit_sha text
    column started_at timestamp with time zone
    column finished_at timestamp with time zone
    column failure_summary text
    column blocking_failures bigint
    column failures bigint
    column warnings bigint
    column open_warnings bigint
    column results bigint
    body SELECT run.source_code,
    body     run.quality_run_id,
    body     run.assessment_type,
    body     run.overall_status,
    body     run.rule_set_version,
    body     run.code_commit_sha,
    body     run.started_at,
    body     run.finished_at,
    body     run.failure_summary,
    body     count(result.result_id) FILTER (WHERE result.result = 'fail'::text AND (result.severity = ANY (ARRAY['BLOCK'::text, 'QUARANTINE'::text]))) AS blocking_failures,
    body     count(result.result_id) FILTER (WHERE result.result = 'fail'::text) AS failures,
    body     count(result.result_id) FILTER (WHERE result.result = 'warn'::text) AS warnings,
    body     count(result.result_id) FILTER (WHERE result.result = 'warn'::text AND result.review_status = 'open'::text) AS open_warnings,
    body     count(result.result_id) AS results
    body    FROM control.data_quality_run run
    body      LEFT JOIN control.data_quality_result result ON result.quality_run_id = run.quality_run_id
    body   WHERE run.started_at = (( SELECT max(latest.started_at) AS max
    body            FROM control.data_quality_run latest
    body           WHERE latest.source_code = run.source_code))
    body   GROUP BY run.source_code, run.quality_run_id;

r control.fbi_ucr_release
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column product_id text NOT NULL
    column ucr_program text NOT NULL
    column offense_code text NOT NULL
    column period_start text NOT NULL
    column period_end text NOT NULL
    column refresh_date date
    column max_data_month text
    column parser_contract_version text NOT NULL
    column subject_scope jsonb NOT NULL
    column release_capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column decision text NOT NULL
    column status text NOT NULL
    column directory_slice_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    column observation_slice_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    column complete boolean NOT NULL
    column published_at timestamp with time zone
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint fbi_ucr_release_check CHECK (((status <> 'published'::text) OR (published_at IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint fbi_ucr_release_check1 CHECK (((decision <> 'ingest'::text) OR (status = 'quarantined'::text) OR complete))
    constraint fbi_ucr_release_check2 CHECK (((decision = 'missing_release_quarantine'::text) OR (refresh_date IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint fbi_ucr_release_decision_check CHECK ((decision = ANY (ARRAY['unchanged'::text, 'ingest'::text, 'missing_release_quarantine'::text, 'backward_refresh_quarantine'::text, 'period_unavailable_quarantine'::text])))
    constraint fbi_ucr_release_directory_slice_count_check CHECK ((directory_slice_count >= 0))
    constraint fbi_ucr_release_max_data_month_check CHECK ((max_data_month ~ '^(0[1-9]|1[0-2])/[0-9]{4}$'::text))
    constraint fbi_ucr_release_observation_slice_count_check CHECK ((observation_slice_count >= 0))
    constraint fbi_ucr_release_offense_code_check CHECK ((offense_code ~ '^[A-Z]{1,3}$'::text))
    constraint fbi_ucr_release_period_end_check CHECK ((period_end ~ '^(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-[0-9]{4}$'::text))
    constraint fbi_ucr_release_period_start_check CHECK ((period_start ~ '^(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-[0-9]{4}$'::text))
    constraint fbi_ucr_release_pkey PRIMARY KEY (run_id)
    constraint fbi_ucr_release_product_id_check CHECK ((btrim(product_id) <> ''::text))
    constraint fbi_ucr_release_product_id_refresh_date_run_id_key UNIQUE (product_id, refresh_date, run_id)
    constraint fbi_ucr_release_release_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (release_capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint fbi_ucr_release_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint fbi_ucr_release_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['captured'::text, 'quarantined'::text, 'silver_ready'::text, 'published'::text])))
    constraint fbi_ucr_release_ucr_program_check CHECK ((btrim(ucr_program) <> ''::text))
    index fbi_ucr_release_latest_idx CREATE INDEX fbi_ucr_release_latest_idx ON control.fbi_ucr_release USING btree (product_id, refresh_date DESC, created_at DESC)
    index fbi_ucr_release_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fbi_ucr_release_pkey ON control.fbi_ucr_release USING btree (run_id)
    index fbi_ucr_release_product_id_refresh_date_run_id_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fbi_ucr_release_product_id_refresh_date_run_id_key ON control.fbi_ucr_release USING btree (product_id, refresh_date, run_id)

    constraint fred_ingestion_slices_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
    constraint fred_ingestion_slices_rows_loaded_check CHECK ((rows_loaded >= 0))

    index fred_ingestion_slices_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fred_ingestion_slices_pkey ON control.fred_ingestion_slices USING btree (id)

r control.ingestion_request
    column request_id uuid NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_code text NOT NULL
    column endpoint text NOT NULL
    column request_parameters jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
    column request_fingerprint text NOT NULL
    column status text NOT NULL
    column attempt_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    column max_attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
    column next_retry_at timestamp with time zone
    column source_watermark jsonb
    column started_at timestamp with time zone
    column finished_at timestamp with time zone
    column last_error text
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint ingestion_request_attempt_count_check CHECK ((attempt_count >= 0))
    constraint ingestion_request_check CHECK ((attempt_count <= max_attempts))
    constraint ingestion_request_check1 CHECK (((finished_at IS NULL) OR ((started_at IS NOT NULL) AND (started_at <= finished_at))))
    constraint ingestion_request_endpoint_check CHECK ((btrim(endpoint) <> ''::text))
    constraint ingestion_request_max_attempts_check CHECK ((max_attempts >= 1))
    constraint ingestion_request_pkey PRIMARY KEY (request_id)
    constraint ingestion_request_request_fingerprint_check CHECK ((request_fingerprint ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
    constraint ingestion_request_request_id_run_id_source_code_endpoint_re_key UNIQUE (request_id, run_id, source_code, endpoint, request_fingerprint)
    constraint ingestion_request_run_id_source_code_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id, source_code) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id, source_code)
    constraint ingestion_request_source_code_check CHECK ((source_code ~ '^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_-]*$'::text))
    constraint ingestion_request_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['planned'::text, 'running'::text, 'captured'::text, 'empty'::text, 'quarantined'::text, 'failed'::text])))
    index ingestion_request_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ingestion_request_pkey ON control.ingestion_request USING btree (request_id)
    index ingestion_request_request_id_run_id_source_code_endpoint_re_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ingestion_request_request_id_run_id_source_code_endpoint_re_key ON control.ingestion_request USING btree (request_id, run_id, source_code, endpoint, request_fingerprint)
    index ingestion_request_retry_idx CREATE INDEX ingestion_request_retry_idx ON control.ingestion_request USING btree (next_retry_at) WHERE ((status = 'failed'::text) AND (next_retry_at IS NOT NULL))
    index ingestion_request_run_status_idx CREATE INDEX ingestion_request_run_status_idx ON control.ingestion_request USING btree (run_id, status)

r control.ingestion_run
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_code text NOT NULL
    column status text NOT NULL
    column started_at timestamp with time zone
    column finished_at timestamp with time zone
    column source_watermark jsonb
    column error_summary text
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint ingestion_run_check CHECK (((finished_at IS NULL) OR ((started_at IS NOT NULL) AND (started_at <= finished_at))))
    constraint ingestion_run_pkey PRIMARY KEY (run_id)
    constraint ingestion_run_run_id_source_code_key UNIQUE (run_id, source_code)
    constraint ingestion_run_source_code_check CHECK ((source_code ~ '^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_-]*$'::text))
    constraint ingestion_run_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['planned'::text, 'running'::text, 'success'::text, 'partial'::text, 'failed'::text, 'cancelled'::text])))
    index ingestion_run_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ingestion_run_pkey ON control.ingestion_run USING btree (run_id)
    index ingestion_run_run_id_source_code_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ingestion_run_run_id_source_code_key ON control.ingestion_run USING btree (run_id, source_code)
    index ingestion_run_source_status_idx CREATE INDEX ingestion_run_source_status_idx ON control.ingestion_run USING btree (source_code, status, created_at DESC)

r control.publisher_ready_event
    column event_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_code text NOT NULL
    column publisher_contract_version text NOT NULL
    column source_watermark text NOT NULL
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
    column status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'::text
    column attempt_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    column available_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column claimed_at timestamp with time zone
    column processed_at timestamp with time zone
    column last_error text
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint publisher_ready_event_attempt_count_check CHECK ((attempt_count >= 0))
    constraint publisher_ready_event_pkey PRIMARY KEY (event_id)
    constraint publisher_ready_event_source_code_publisher_contract_versio_key UNIQUE (source_code, publisher_contract_version, source_watermark)
    constraint publisher_ready_event_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'processing'::text, 'processed'::text, 'failed'::text, 'superseded'::text])))
    index publisher_ready_event_pending_idx CREATE INDEX publisher_ready_event_pending_idx ON control.publisher_ready_event USING btree (status, available_at, created_at)
    index publisher_ready_event_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX publisher_ready_event_pkey ON control.publisher_ready_event USING btree (event_id)
    index publisher_ready_event_source_code_publisher_contract_versio_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX publisher_ready_event_source_code_publisher_contract_versio_key ON control.publisher_ready_event USING btree (source_code, publisher_contract_version, source_watermark)

r control.schema_migration_state
    column component_name text NOT NULL
    column ddl_hash text NOT NULL
    column applied_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint schema_migration_state_pkey PRIMARY KEY (component_name)
    index schema_migration_state_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX schema_migration_state_pkey ON control.schema_migration_state USING btree (component_name)

r control.serving_refresh_chunk_state
    column source_code text NOT NULL
    column chunk_start date NOT NULL
    column chunk_end date NOT NULL
    column target_silver_ingested_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
    column completed_silver_ingested_at timestamp with time zone
    column status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING'::text
    column attempt_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    column last_refresh_started_at timestamp with time zone
    column last_refresh_completed_at timestamp with time zone
    column last_error text
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint serving_refresh_chunk_state_check CHECK ((chunk_end >= chunk_start))
    constraint serving_refresh_chunk_state_pkey PRIMARY KEY (source_code, chunk_start, chunk_end)
    constraint serving_refresh_chunk_state_source_code_check CHECK ((source_code ~ '^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_-]*$'::text))
    constraint serving_refresh_chunk_state_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['PENDING'::text, 'RUNNING'::text, 'COMPLETE'::text, 'FAILED'::text])))
    index serving_refresh_chunk_state_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX serving_refresh_chunk_state_pkey ON control.serving_refresh_chunk_state USING btree (source_code, chunk_start, chunk_end)
    index serving_refresh_chunk_state_status_idx CREATE INDEX serving_refresh_chunk_state_status_idx ON control.serving_refresh_chunk_state USING btree (source_code, status, chunk_start)

r control.serving_refresh_state
    column source_code text NOT NULL
    column last_silver_ingested_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT '-infinity'::timestamp with time zone
    column last_refresh_started_at timestamp with time zone
    column last_refresh_completed_at timestamp with time zone
    column last_window_start date
    column last_window_end date
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column last_full_reserve_started_at timestamp with time zone
    constraint serving_refresh_state_pkey PRIMARY KEY (source_code)
    constraint serving_refresh_state_source_code_check CHECK ((source_code ~ '^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_-]*$'::text))
    index serving_refresh_state_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX serving_refresh_state_pkey ON control.serving_refresh_state USING btree (source_code)

r control.usda_nass_release
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column product_id text NOT NULL
    column slice_mode text NOT NULL
    column parser_contract_version text NOT NULL
    column extraction_watermark text NOT NULL
    column total_row_count bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    column slice_counts jsonb NOT NULL
    column field_signature jsonb NOT NULL
    column decision text NOT NULL
    column status text NOT NULL
    column captured_row_count bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    column slice_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    column complete boolean NOT NULL
    column published_at timestamp with time zone
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint usda_nass_release_captured_row_count_check CHECK ((captured_row_count >= 0))
    constraint usda_nass_release_check CHECK (((status <> 'published'::text) OR (published_at IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint usda_nass_release_check1 CHECK (((decision <> 'ingest'::text) OR (status = 'quarantined'::text) OR complete))
    constraint usda_nass_release_check2 CHECK (((decision <> 'ingest'::text) OR (status = 'quarantined'::text) OR (btrim(extraction_watermark) <> ''::text)))
    constraint usda_nass_release_decision_check CHECK ((decision = ANY (ARRAY['unchanged'::text, 'ingest'::text, 'over_limit_quarantine'::text, 'partial_slice_quarantine'::text, 'row_count_drift_quarantine'::text, 'schema_change_quarantine'::text, 'backward_watermark_quarantine'::text, 'invalid_watermark_quarantine'::text])))
    constraint usda_nass_release_parser_contract_version_check CHECK ((btrim(parser_contract_version) <> ''::text))
    constraint usda_nass_release_pkey PRIMARY KEY (run_id)
    constraint usda_nass_release_product_id_check CHECK ((btrim(product_id) <> ''::text))
    constraint usda_nass_release_product_id_extraction_watermark_run_id_key UNIQUE (product_id, extraction_watermark, run_id)
    constraint usda_nass_release_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint usda_nass_release_slice_count_check CHECK ((slice_count >= 0))
    constraint usda_nass_release_slice_mode_check CHECK ((slice_mode = ANY (ARRAY['recent'::text, 'full'::text])))
    constraint usda_nass_release_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['captured'::text, 'quarantined'::text, 'silver_ready'::text, 'published'::text])))
    constraint usda_nass_release_total_row_count_check CHECK ((total_row_count >= 0))
    index usda_nass_release_latest_idx CREATE INDEX usda_nass_release_latest_idx ON control.usda_nass_release USING btree (product_id, extraction_watermark DESC, created_at DESC)
    index usda_nass_release_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX usda_nass_release_pkey ON control.usda_nass_release USING btree (run_id)
    index usda_nass_release_product_id_extraction_watermark_run_id_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX usda_nass_release_product_id_extraction_watermark_run_id_key ON control.usda_nass_release USING btree (product_id, extraction_watermark, run_id)

r control.usda_nass_slice
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column slice_key text NOT NULL
    column product_id text NOT NULL
    column agg_level_desc text NOT NULL
    column year integer NOT NULL
    column provider_count bigint NOT NULL
    column captured_row_count bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    column count_capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column data_capture_id uuid
    column status text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint usda_nass_slice_agg_level_desc_check CHECK ((agg_level_desc = ANY (ARRAY['NATIONAL'::text, 'STATE'::text, 'COUNTY'::text])))
    constraint usda_nass_slice_captured_row_count_check CHECK ((captured_row_count >= 0))
    constraint usda_nass_slice_check CHECK (((status <> 'captured'::text) OR (data_capture_id IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint usda_nass_slice_check1 CHECK (((status = 'captured'::text) OR (captured_row_count = 0)))
    constraint usda_nass_slice_count_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (count_capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint usda_nass_slice_data_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (data_capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint usda_nass_slice_pkey PRIMARY KEY (run_id, slice_key)
    constraint usda_nass_slice_provider_count_check CHECK ((provider_count >= 0))
    constraint usda_nass_slice_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.usda_nass_release(run_id)
    constraint usda_nass_slice_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['preflighted'::text, 'captured'::text, 'empty'::text, 'over_limit'::text, 'partial'::text, 'skipped'::text])))
    constraint usda_nass_slice_year_check CHECK (((year >= 1800) AND (year <= 2200)))
    index usda_nass_slice_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX usda_nass_slice_pkey ON control.usda_nass_slice USING btree (run_id, slice_key)
    index usda_nass_slice_product_idx CREATE INDEX usda_nass_slice_product_idx ON control.usda_nass_slice USING btree (product_id, agg_level_desc, year)

    column county_fips text
    column place_fips text
    column state_name text

    column longitude double precision

    column refreshed_at timestamp with time zone

    body     place_name,
    body     latitude,

    body     refreshed_at
    body    FROM gold_glossary.dim_geo_latest;

v gold.tile_boundary
    column geo_id text
    column geo_level text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column latitude double precision
    column longitude double precision

    body     geo_level,
    body     state_fips,
    body     county_fips,
    body     state_name,
    body     county_name,
    body     latitude,
    body     longitude,
    body     geo_geom,
    body     boundary_vintage
    body    FROM gold_glossary.dim_geo_latest
    body   WHERE (geo_level = ANY (ARRAY[gold_glossary.geo_grain('state'::text), gold_glossary.geo_grain('county'::text)])) AND geography_state = 'current'::text AND geo_geom IS NOT NULL;

v gold.v_metric_latest_by_geo
    column source_code text
    column source text
    column observation_date date
    column period text
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date
    column release_date date
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone
    column geo_id text
    column geo_level text
    column geo_name text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    column value numeric
    column value_type text
    column units text
    column unit text
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column dataset_code text
    column dataset text
    column vintage_year integer
    column vintage text
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column margin_of_error_pct numeric
    body SELECT v_metric_latest_by_geo.source_code,
    body     v_metric_latest_by_geo.source,
    body     v_metric_latest_by_geo.observation_date,
    body     v_metric_latest_by_geo.period,
    body     v_metric_latest_by_geo.duration_start,
    body     v_metric_latest_by_geo.duration_end,
    body     v_metric_latest_by_geo.time_sk,
    body     v_metric_latest_by_geo.as_of_date,
    body     v_metric_latest_by_geo.release_date,
    body     v_metric_latest_by_geo.updated_at,
    body     v_metric_latest_by_geo.geo_id,
    body     v_metric_latest_by_geo.geo_level,
    body     v_metric_latest_by_geo.geo_name,
    body     v_metric_latest_by_geo.state_fips,
    body     v_metric_latest_by_geo.county_fips,
    body     v_metric_latest_by_geo.state_name,
    body     v_metric_latest_by_geo.county_name,

r gold_bls.dim_bls_measure
    column bls_measure_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('gold_bls.dim_bls_measure_bls_measure_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column program_code text NOT NULL
    column measure_code text NOT NULL
    column metric_key text NOT NULL
    column metric_display_name text NOT NULL
    column unit_of_measure text
    column value_type text NOT NULL
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint dim_bls_measure_metric_key_key UNIQUE (metric_key)
    constraint dim_bls_measure_pkey PRIMARY KEY (bls_measure_sk)
    constraint dim_bls_measure_program_code_measure_code_key UNIQUE (program_code, measure_code)
    constraint dim_bls_measure_value_type_check CHECK ((value_type = ANY (ARRAY['LEVEL'::text, 'RATE'::text, 'INDEX'::text, 'PERCENT'::text, 'CURRENCY'::text, 'RATIO'::text, 'OTHER'::text])))
    index dim_bls_measure_metric_key_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_bls_measure_metric_key_key ON gold_bls.dim_bls_measure USING btree (metric_key)
    index dim_bls_measure_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_bls_measure_pkey ON gold_bls.dim_bls_measure USING btree (bls_measure_sk)
    index dim_bls_measure_program_code_measure_code_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_bls_measure_program_code_measure_code_key ON gold_bls.dim_bls_measure USING btree (program_code, measure_code)

r gold_bls.dim_bls_series
    column bls_series_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('gold_bls.dim_bls_series_bls_series_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column bls_survey_sk bigint NOT NULL
    column program_code text NOT NULL
    column series_id text NOT NULL
    column series_title text
    column measure_name text
    column measure_category text NOT NULL
    column unit_of_measure text
    column value_type text NOT NULL
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column geographic_level text
    column gold_metric_name text
    column analytic_role text
    column semantic_notes text
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint dim_bls_series_bls_survey_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (bls_survey_sk) REFERENCES gold_bls.dim_bls_survey(bls_survey_sk)
    constraint dim_bls_series_measure_category_check CHECK ((measure_category = ANY (ARRAY['EMPLOYMENT'::text, 'UNEMPLOYMENT'::text, 'LABOR_FORCE'::text, 'PARTICIPATION'::text, 'POPULATION'::text, 'EARNINGS'::text, 'HOURS'::text, 'PRICE_INDEX'::text, 'OPENINGS'::text, 'HIRES'::text, 'QUITS'::text, 'LAYOFFS'::text, 'SEPARATIONS'::text, 'OTHER'::text])))
    constraint dim_bls_series_pkey PRIMARY KEY (bls_series_sk)
    constraint dim_bls_series_series_id_key UNIQUE (series_id)
    constraint dim_bls_series_value_type_check CHECK ((value_type = ANY (ARRAY['LEVEL'::text, 'RATE'::text, 'INDEX'::text, 'PERCENT'::text, 'CURRENCY'::text, 'RATIO'::text, 'OTHER'::text])))
    index dim_bls_series_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_bls_series_pkey ON gold_bls.dim_bls_series USING btree (bls_series_sk)
    index dim_bls_series_series_id_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_bls_series_series_id_key ON gold_bls.dim_bls_series USING btree (series_id)

r gold_bls.dim_bls_survey
    column bls_survey_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('gold_bls.dim_bls_survey_bls_survey_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column program_code text NOT NULL
    column survey_name text NOT NULL
    column survey_universe text
    column observation_basis text NOT NULL
    column primary_concept text
    column id_construction_type text
    column comparison_warning text
    column reference_url text
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint dim_bls_survey_observation_basis_check CHECK ((observation_basis = ANY (ARRAY['PEOPLE'::text, 'JOBS'::text, 'PRICES'::text, 'FLOWS'::text])))
    constraint dim_bls_survey_pkey PRIMARY KEY (bls_survey_sk)
    constraint dim_bls_survey_program_code_key UNIQUE (program_code)
    index dim_bls_survey_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_bls_survey_pkey ON gold_bls.dim_bls_survey USING btree (bls_survey_sk)
    index dim_bls_survey_program_code_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_bls_survey_program_code_key ON gold_bls.dim_bls_survey USING btree (program_code)

v gold_bls.fact_bls_observation
    column geo_id character varying(255)
    column geo_level text
    column time_sk integer
    column period_date date
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column bls_survey_sk bigint
    column bls_series_sk bigint
    column program_code text
    column value numeric
    column period_code character varying(10)
    column seasonal_adjustment_status character varying(1)
    column observation_basis text
    column measure_category text
    column value_type text
    column as_of_date date
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone
    column measure_code character varying(10)
    column value_status text
    column source_value text
    column capture_id uuid
    body SELECT s.geo_id,
    body         CASE
    body             WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(BOTH FROM s.geo_level), ''::text) <> ''::text THEN gold_glossary.geo_grain(s.geo_level::text)
    body             WHEN s.geo_id::text = 'us:1'::text THEN 'NATIONAL'::text
    body             WHEN s.geo_id::text ~~ 'state:%|county:%'::text THEN 'COUNTY'::text
    body             WHEN s.geo_id::text ~~ 'state:%'::text THEN 'STATE'::text
    body             ELSE 'NATIONAL'::text
    body         END AS geo_level,
    body     s.time_sk,
    body     s.period_date,
    body     s.duration_start,
    body     s.duration_end,
    body     sr.bls_survey_sk,
    body     sr.bls_series_sk,
    body     upper(s.program::text) AS program_code,
    body     s.value,
    body     s.period AS period_code,
    body     s.seasonal_adjustment AS seasonal_adjustment_status,
    body     sv.observation_basis,
    body     sr.measure_category,
    body     sr.value_type,
    body     s.ingested_at::date AS as_of_date,
    body     s.ingested_at AS updated_at,
    body     s.measure_code,
    body     s.value_status,
    body     s.source_value,
    body     s.capture_id
    body    FROM silver_bls.fact_labor_statistics s
    body      JOIN gold_bls.dim_bls_series sr ON sr.series_id = s.series_id::text
    body      JOIN gold_bls.dim_bls_survey sv ON sv.bls_survey_sk = sr.bls_survey_sk
    body   WHERE s.series_id IS NOT NULL AND s.series_id::text <> ''::text;

v gold_bls.fact_observation
    column source_code text
    column source text
    column observation_date date
    column period text
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date
    column release_date date
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone
    column geo_id text
    column geo_level text
    column geo_name text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    column value numeric
    column value_type text
    column units text
    column unit text
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column dataset_code text
    column dataset text
    column vintage_year integer
    column vintage text
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column margin_of_error_pct numeric
    body SELECT source_code,
    body     source_code AS source,
    body     observation_date,
    body     observation_date::text AS period,
    body     duration_start,
    body     duration_end,
    body     time_sk,
    body     as_of_date,
    body     as_of_date AS release_date,
    body     updated_at,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_level,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_name(place_name, county_name, state_name, geo_id) AS geo_name,
    body     state_fips,
    body     county_fips,
    body     state_name,
    body     county_name,
    body     geo_latitude,
    body     geo_longitude,
    body     metric_code,
    body     metric_display_name,
    body     value,
    body     value_type,
    body     units,
    body     units AS unit,
    body     seasonal_adjustment_status,
    body     program_code AS dataset_code,
    body     program_code AS dataset,
    body     NULL::integer AS vintage_year,
    body     NULL::text AS vintage,
    body     NULL::numeric AS margin_of_error,
    body     NULL::numeric AS margin_of_error_pct
    body    FROM gold_bls.rpt_bls_observations;

v gold_bls.measure_export
    column bls_measure_sk bigint
    column program_code text
    column source_object_key text
    column metric_display_name text
    column unit_of_measure text
    column value_type text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    body SELECT measure.bls_measure_sk,
    body     measure.program_code,
    body     measure.metric_key AS source_object_key,
    body     measure.metric_display_name,
    body     measure.unit_of_measure,
    body     measure.value_type,
    body     COALESCE(served.valid_geo_grains, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body     COALESCE(served.publication_time, max(fact.updated_at)) AS publication_time
    body    FROM gold_bls.dim_bls_measure measure
    body      JOIN gold_bls.fact_bls_observation fact ON fact.program_code = measure.program_code AND fact.measure_code::text = measure.measure_code
    body      LEFT JOIN ( SELECT latest.metric_code,
    body             array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_level) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_level))) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body             max(latest.updated_at) AS publication_time
    body            FROM gold_bls.mv_bls_latest latest
    body           GROUP BY latest.metric_code) served ON served.metric_code = ('BLS:'::text || measure.metric_key)
    body   GROUP BY measure.bls_measure_sk, served.valid_geo_grains, served.publication_time;

v gold_bls.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'BLS'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     series.series_id AS source_object_key,
    body     'series'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     COALESCE(NULLIF(series.series_title, ''::text), series.series_id) AS metric_display_name,
    body     series.unit_of_measure AS units,
    body     series.value_type AS measure_kind,
    body     COALESCE(served.valid_geo_grains, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY['MONTHLY'::text] AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_bls', 'relation', 'fact_bls_observation', 'key', series.series_id) AS physical_lineage,
    body     COALESCE(served.publication_time, series.updated_at)::text AS source_watermark,
    body     NULL::uuid AS source_run_id,
    body     COALESCE(served.publication_time, series.updated_at) AS publication_time,
    body     'U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics'::text AS source_name,
    body     'official-statistics'::text AS source_type,
    body     survey.reference_url
    body    FROM gold_bls.dim_bls_series series
    body      JOIN gold_bls.dim_bls_survey survey USING (bls_survey_sk)
    body      LEFT JOIN ( SELECT latest.series_id,
    body             array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_level) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_level))) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body             max(latest.updated_at) AS publication_time
    body            FROM gold_bls.mv_bls_latest latest
    body           WHERE latest.metric_code = ('BLS:'::text || latest.series_id)
    body           GROUP BY latest.series_id) served ON served.series_id = series.series_id
    body   WHERE NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
    body            FROM gold_bls.fact_bls_observation fact
    body              JOIN gold_bls.dim_bls_measure measure ON measure.program_code = fact.program_code AND measure.measure_code = fact.measure_code::text
    body           WHERE fact.bls_series_sk = series.bls_series_sk)) AND ((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
    body            FROM gold_bls.fact_bls_observation fact
    body           WHERE fact.bls_series_sk = series.bls_series_sk)) OR NOT (series.program_code IN ( SELECT DISTINCT dim_bls_measure.program_code
    body            FROM gold_bls.dim_bls_measure)))
    body   GROUP BY series.bls_series_sk, survey.bls_survey_sk, served.valid_geo_grains, served.publication_time
    body UNION ALL
    body  SELECT 'BLS'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     export.source_object_key,
    body     'measure'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     export.metric_display_name,
    body     export.unit_of_measure AS units,
    body     export.value_type AS measure_kind,
    body     export.valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY['MONTHLY'::text] AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_bls', 'relation', 'fact_bls_observation', 'key', export.source_object_key) AS physical_lineage,
    body     export.publication_time::text AS source_watermark,
    body     NULL::uuid AS source_run_id,
    body     export.publication_time,
    body     'U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics'::text AS source_name,
    body     'official-statistics'::text AS source_type,
    body     survey.reference_url
    body    FROM gold_bls.measure_export export
    body      JOIN gold_bls.dim_bls_survey survey ON survey.program_code = export.program_code;

r gold_bls.mv_bls_latest
    column source_code text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'BLS'::text
    column observation_date date NOT NULL
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date NOT NULL
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
    column geo_id text NOT NULL
    column geo_level text NOT NULL
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column place_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column series_id text NOT NULL
    column program_code text NOT NULL
    column survey_name text
    column series_title text
    column measure_name text
    column measure_category text
    column observation_basis text
    column units text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'valid'::text
    column source_value text
    column capture_id uuid
    column value_type text
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column gold_metric_name text
    column comparison_warning text
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    index ix_mv_bls_latest_metric_geo CREATE INDEX ix_mv_bls_latest_metric_geo ON gold_bls.mv_bls_latest USING btree (metric_code, geo_id)
    index ix_mv_bls_latest_observation_date CREATE INDEX ix_mv_bls_latest_observation_date ON gold_bls.mv_bls_latest USING btree (observation_date)
    index ix_mv_bls_latest_source_metric CREATE INDEX ix_mv_bls_latest_source_metric ON gold_bls.mv_bls_latest USING btree (source_code, metric_code)
    index uq_mv_bls_latest CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_mv_bls_latest ON gold_bls.mv_bls_latest USING btree (geo_id, series_id, COALESCE(metric_code, ''::text))

r gold_bls.rpt_bls_observations
    column source_code text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'BLS'::text
    column observation_date date NOT NULL
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date NOT NULL
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
    column geo_id text NOT NULL
    column geo_level text NOT NULL
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column place_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column series_id text NOT NULL
    column program_code text NOT NULL
    column survey_name text
    column series_title text
    column measure_name text
    column measure_category text
    column observation_basis text
    column units text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'valid'::text
    column source_value text
    column capture_id uuid
    column value_type text
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column gold_metric_name text
    column comparison_warning text
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    constraint rpt_bls_observations_published_value_check CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint rpt_bls_observations_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'missing'::text, 'invalid'::text])))
    index ix_rpt_bls_latest_selection CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_bls_latest_selection ON gold_bls.rpt_bls_observations USING btree (geo_id, series_id, metric_code, observation_date DESC, updated_at DESC)
    index ix_rpt_bls_observations_metric_date CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_bls_observations_metric_date ON gold_bls.rpt_bls_observations USING btree (metric_code, observation_date)
    index ix_rpt_bls_observations_metric_geo_date CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_bls_observations_metric_geo_date ON gold_bls.rpt_bls_observations USING btree (metric_code, geo_id, observation_date)
    index ix_rpt_bls_observations_obs_brin CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_bls_observations_obs_brin ON gold_bls.rpt_bls_observations USING brin (observation_date)
    index ix_rpt_bls_observations_source_geo_date CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_bls_observations_source_geo_date ON gold_bls.rpt_bls_observations USING btree (source_code, geo_id, observation_date)
    index ix_rpt_bls_observations_updated_at CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_bls_observations_updated_at ON gold_bls.rpt_bls_observations USING btree (updated_at DESC)
    index uq_rpt_bls_observations_nk CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_rpt_bls_observations_nk ON gold_bls.rpt_bls_observations USING btree (geo_id, observation_date, series_id, COALESCE(metric_code, ''::text))

v gold_bls.v_metric_latest_by_geo
    column source_code text
    column source text
    column observation_date date
    column period text
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date
    column release_date date
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone
    column geo_id text
    column geo_level text
    column geo_name text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    column value numeric
    column value_type text
    column units text
    column unit text
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column dataset_code text
    column dataset text
    column vintage_year integer
    column vintage text
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column margin_of_error_pct numeric
    body SELECT source_code,
    body     source_code AS source,
    body     observation_date,
    body     observation_date::text AS period,
    body     duration_start,
    body     duration_end,
    body     time_sk,
    body     as_of_date,
    body     as_of_date AS release_date,
    body     updated_at,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_level,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_name(place_name, county_name, state_name, geo_id) AS geo_name,
    body     state_fips,
    body     county_fips,
    body     state_name,
    body     county_name,
    body     geo_latitude,
    body     geo_longitude,
    body     metric_code,
    body     metric_display_name,
    body     value,
    body     value_type,
    body     units,
    body     units AS unit,
    body     seasonal_adjustment_status,
    body     program_code AS dataset_code,
    body     program_code AS dataset,
    body     NULL::integer AS vintage_year,
    body     NULL::text AS vintage,
    body     NULL::numeric AS margin_of_error,
    body     NULL::numeric AS margin_of_error_pct
    body    FROM gold_bls.mv_bls_latest;
