v gold_cdc.health_observation
    column observation_sk bigint
    column asset_id text
    column dataset_title text
    column release_watermark text
    column measure_id text
    column measure_label text
    column topic text
    column value_type_id text
    column value_type_label text
    column period_start integer
    column period_end integer
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geography_status text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column unit text
    column adjustment_status text
    column confidence_lower numeric
    column confidence_upper numeric
    column footnote_code text
    column footnote_text text
    column stratum_id text
    column strata jsonb
    column estimate_method text
    column population_basis text
    column total_population numeric
    column population_18_plus numeric
    column methodology_url text
    column geography_basis text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    body SELECT fact.observation_sk,
    body     fact.asset_id,
    body     release.title AS dataset_title,
    body     fact.release_watermark,
    body     fact.measure_id,
    body     measure.measure_label,
    body     measure.topic,
    body     fact.value_type_id,
    body     measure.value_type_label,
    body     fact.period_start,
    body     fact.period_end,
    body     fact.geo_id,
    body     fact.geo_sk,
    body     fact.geo_type,
    body     fact.geography_status,
    body     fact.value_source,
    body     fact.value,
    body     fact.value_status,
    body     fact.unit,
    body     fact.adjustment_status,
    body     fact.confidence_lower,
    body     fact.confidence_upper,
    body     fact.footnote_code,
    body     fact.footnote_text,
    body     fact.stratum_id,
    body     stratum.strata,
    body     fact.estimate_method,
    body     fact.population_basis,
    body     fact.total_population,
    body     fact.population_18_plus,
    body     release.methodology_url,
    body     release.geography_basis,
    body     fact.source_record_id,
    body     fact.capture_id
    body    FROM silver_cdc.fact_health_observation fact
    body      JOIN silver_cdc.dim_dataset_release release ON release.asset_id = fact.asset_id AND release.release_watermark = fact.release_watermark
    body      JOIN silver_cdc.dim_measure measure ON measure.asset_id = fact.asset_id AND measure.measure_id = fact.measure_id AND measure.value_type_id = fact.value_type_id
    body      JOIN silver_cdc.dim_stratum stratum USING (stratum_id)
    body   WHERE release.status = 'published'::text AND fact.geography_status <> 'unsupported'::text;

v gold_cdc.latest_release_observation
    column observation_sk bigint
    column asset_id text
    column dataset_title text
    column release_watermark text
    column measure_id text
    column measure_label text
    column topic text
    column value_type_id text
    column value_type_label text
    column period_start integer
    column period_end integer
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geography_status text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column unit text
    column adjustment_status text
    column confidence_lower numeric
    column confidence_upper numeric
    column footnote_code text
    column footnote_text text
    column stratum_id text
    column strata jsonb
    column estimate_method text
    column population_basis text
    column total_population numeric
    column population_18_plus numeric
    column methodology_url text
    column geography_basis text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    body SELECT observation.observation_sk,
    body     observation.asset_id,
    body     observation.dataset_title,
    body     observation.release_watermark,
    body     observation.measure_id,
    body     observation.measure_label,
    body     observation.topic,
    body     observation.value_type_id,
    body     observation.value_type_label,
    body     observation.period_start,
    body     observation.period_end,
    body     observation.geo_id,
    body     observation.geo_sk,
    body     observation.geo_type,
    body     observation.geography_status,
    body     observation.value_source,
    body     observation.value,
    body     observation.value_status,
    body     observation.unit,
    body     observation.adjustment_status,
    body     observation.confidence_lower,
    body     observation.confidence_upper,
    body     observation.footnote_code,
    body     observation.footnote_text,
    body     observation.stratum_id,
    body     observation.strata,
    body     observation.estimate_method,
    body     observation.population_basis,
    body     observation.total_population,
    body     observation.population_18_plus,
    body     observation.methodology_url,
    body     observation.geography_basis,
    body     observation.source_record_id,
    body     observation.capture_id
    body    FROM gold_cdc.health_observation observation
    body      JOIN ( SELECT dim_dataset_release.asset_id,
    body             max(dim_dataset_release.release_watermark::bigint) AS release_watermark
    body            FROM silver_cdc.dim_dataset_release
    body           WHERE dim_dataset_release.status = 'published'::text
    body           GROUP BY dim_dataset_release.asset_id) latest ON latest.asset_id = observation.asset_id AND latest.release_watermark::text = observation.release_watermark;

v gold_cdc.measure_export
    column source_dataset text
    column source_measure_code text
    column source_value_type_code text
    column display_name text
    column topic text
    column value_type_label text
    column unit text
    column adjustment_status text
    column estimate_method text
    column population_basis text
    column source_watermark text
    column methodology_url text
    column schema_version text
    body SELECT measure.asset_id AS source_dataset,
    body     measure.measure_id AS source_measure_code,
    body     measure.value_type_id AS source_value_type_code,
    body     measure.measure_label AS display_name,
    body     measure.topic,
    body     measure.value_type_label,
    body     measure.unit,
    body     measure.adjustment_status,
    body     measure.estimate_method,
    body     measure.population_basis,
    body     release.release_watermark AS source_watermark,
    body     release.methodology_url,
    body     release.parser_contract_version AS schema_version
    body    FROM silver_cdc.dim_measure measure
    body      JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT candidate.asset_id,
    body             candidate.release_watermark,
    body             candidate.socrata_id,
    body             candidate.title,
    body             candidate.methodology_url,
    body             candidate.geography_basis,
    body             candidate.parser_contract_version,
    body             candidate.estimate_method,
    body             candidate.population_basis,
    body             candidate.metadata_capture_id,
    body             candidate.source_run_id,
    body             candidate.source_record_count,
    body             candidate.quarantine_count,
    body             candidate.status,
    body             candidate.reconciled_at,
    body             candidate.published_at,
    body             candidate.created_at,
    body             candidate.updated_at
    body            FROM silver_cdc.dim_dataset_release candidate
    body           WHERE candidate.asset_id = measure.asset_id AND candidate.status = 'published'::text
    body           ORDER BY (candidate.release_watermark::bigint) DESC
    body          LIMIT 1) release ON true;

v gold_cdc.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'CDC'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     (((measure.asset_id || ':'::text) || measure.measure_id) || ':'::text) || measure.value_type_id AS source_object_key,
    body     'measure'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     measure.measure_label AS metric_display_name,
    body     measure.unit AS units,
    body     'source_fact'::text AS measure_kind,
    body     measure.valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY['ANNUAL'::text] AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_cdc', 'relation', 'health_observation', 'asset_id', measure.asset_id, 'measure_id', measure.measure_id, 'value_type_id', measure.value_type_id) AS physical_lineage,
    body     release.release_watermark AS source_watermark,
    body     release.source_run_id,
    body     release.published_at AS publication_time,
    body     'Centers for Disease Control and Prevention'::text AS source_name,
    body     'government-public-health'::text AS source_type,
    body     release.methodology_url AS reference_url
    body    FROM ( SELECT measure_1.asset_id,
    body             measure_1.measure_id,
    body             measure_1.value_type_id,
    body             measure_1.measure_label,
    body             measure_1.unit,
    body             array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(fact.geo_type) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(fact.geo_type))) AS valid_geo_grains
    body            FROM silver_cdc.dim_measure measure_1
    body              JOIN silver_cdc.fact_health_observation fact ON fact.asset_id = measure_1.asset_id AND fact.measure_id = measure_1.measure_id AND fact.value_type_id = measure_1.value_type_id
    body              JOIN silver_cdc.dim_dataset_release release_1 ON release_1.asset_id = fact.asset_id AND release_1.release_watermark = fact.release_watermark
    body           WHERE release_1.status = 'published'::text AND fact.geography_status <> 'unsupported'::text
    body           GROUP BY measure_1.asset_id, measure_1.measure_id, measure_1.value_type_id, measure_1.measure_label, measure_1.unit) measure
    body      JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT candidate.asset_id,
    body             candidate.release_watermark,
    body             candidate.socrata_id,
    body             candidate.title,
    body             candidate.methodology_url,
    body             candidate.geography_basis,
    body             candidate.parser_contract_version,
    body             candidate.estimate_method,
    body             candidate.population_basis,
    body             candidate.metadata_capture_id,
    body             candidate.source_run_id,
    body             candidate.source_record_count,
    body             candidate.quarantine_count,
    body             candidate.status,
    body             candidate.reconciled_at,
    body             candidate.published_at,
    body             candidate.created_at,
    body             candidate.updated_at
    body            FROM silver_cdc.dim_dataset_release candidate
    body           WHERE candidate.asset_id = measure.asset_id AND candidate.status = 'published'::text
    body           ORDER BY (candidate.release_watermark::bigint) DESC
    body          LIMIT 1) release ON true;

r gold_census.dim_acs_table
    column acs_table_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('gold_census.dim_acs_table_acs_table_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column dataset_code text NOT NULL
    column vintage_year integer NOT NULL
    column table_id text NOT NULL
    column table_title text
    column concept text
    column universe text
    column survey_span_years integer NOT NULL
    column reference_url text
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint dim_acs_table_dataset_code_check CHECK ((dataset_code = ANY (ARRAY['acs1'::text, 'acs5'::text])))
    constraint dim_acs_table_dataset_code_vintage_year_table_id_key UNIQUE (dataset_code, vintage_year, table_id)
    constraint dim_acs_table_pkey PRIMARY KEY (acs_table_sk)
    constraint dim_acs_table_survey_span_years_check CHECK ((survey_span_years = ANY (ARRAY[1, 5])))
    index dim_acs_table_dataset_code_vintage_year_table_id_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_acs_table_dataset_code_vintage_year_table_id_key ON gold_census.dim_acs_table USING btree (dataset_code, vintage_year, table_id)
    index dim_acs_table_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_acs_table_pkey ON gold_census.dim_acs_table USING btree (acs_table_sk)

r gold_census.dim_acs_variable
    column acs_variable_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('gold_census.dim_acs_variable_acs_variable_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column acs_table_sk bigint NOT NULL
    column dataset_code text NOT NULL
    column vintage_year integer NOT NULL
    column variable_code text NOT NULL
    column variable_label text
    column concept text
    column universe text
    column value_role text NOT NULL
    column denominator_hint text
    column is_publishable_default boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint dim_acs_variable_acs_table_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (acs_table_sk) REFERENCES gold_census.dim_acs_table(acs_table_sk)
    constraint dim_acs_variable_dataset_code_check CHECK ((dataset_code = ANY (ARRAY['acs1'::text, 'acs5'::text])))
    constraint dim_acs_variable_dataset_code_vintage_year_variable_code_key UNIQUE (dataset_code, vintage_year, variable_code)
    constraint dim_acs_variable_pkey PRIMARY KEY (acs_variable_sk)
    constraint dim_acs_variable_value_role_check CHECK ((value_role = ANY (ARRAY['ESTIMATE'::text, 'MOE'::text, 'ANNOTATION'::text])))
    index dim_acs_variable_dataset_code_vintage_year_variable_code_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_acs_variable_dataset_code_vintage_year_variable_code_key ON gold_census.dim_acs_variable USING btree (dataset_code, vintage_year, variable_code)
    index dim_acs_variable_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_acs_variable_pkey ON gold_census.dim_acs_variable USING btree (acs_variable_sk)

v gold_census.fact_acs_observation
    column geo_id character varying(255)
    column geo_level text
    column time_sk integer
    column observation_date date
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column acs_table_sk bigint
    column acs_variable_sk bigint
    column dataset_code character varying(50)
    column vintage_year integer
    column estimate_value numeric
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column margin_of_error_pct numeric
    column estimate_annotation text
    column moe_annotation text
    column as_of_date date
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone
    column value_status text
    column source_value text
    column capture_id uuid
    body SELECT s.geo_id,
    body         CASE
    body             WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(BOTH FROM s.geo_level), ''::text) <> ''::text THEN gold_glossary.geo_grain(s.geo_level::text)
    body             WHEN s.geo_id::text = 'us:1'::text THEN 'NATIONAL'::text
    body             WHEN s.geo_id::text ~~ 'state:%|county:%'::text THEN 'COUNTY'::text
    body             WHEN s.geo_id::text ~~ 'state:%'::text THEN 'STATE'::text
    body             ELSE 'NATIONAL'::text
    body         END AS geo_level,
    body     s.time_sk,
    body     make_date(s.estimate_year, 1, 1) AS observation_date,
    body     s.duration_start,
    body     s.duration_end,
    body     av.acs_table_sk,
    body     av.acs_variable_sk,
    body     s.dataset AS dataset_code,
    body     s.estimate_year AS vintage_year,
    body     s.estimate_value,
    body     s.margin_of_error,
    body     s.margin_of_error_pct,
    body     NULL::text AS estimate_annotation,
    body     NULL::text AS moe_annotation,
    body     s.ingested_at::date AS as_of_date,
    body     s.ingested_at AS updated_at,
    body     s.value_status,
    body     s.source_value,
    body     s.capture_id
    body    FROM silver_census.fact_demographics s
    body      JOIN gold_census.dim_acs_variable av ON av.dataset_code = s.dataset::text AND av.vintage_year = s.estimate_year AND av.variable_code = s.variable_code::text
    body   WHERE s.variable_code IS NOT NULL AND s.variable_code::text <> ''::text;

v gold_census.fact_observation
    column source_code text
    column source text
    column observation_date date
    column period text
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date
    column release_date date
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone
    column geo_id text
    column geo_level text
    column geo_name text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    column value numeric
    column value_type text
    column units text
    column unit text
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column dataset_code text
    column dataset text
    column vintage_year integer
    column vintage text
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column margin_of_error_pct numeric
    body SELECT source_code,
    body     source_code AS source,
    body     observation_date,
    body     observation_date::text AS period,
    body     duration_start,
    body     duration_end,
    body     time_sk,
    body     as_of_date,
    body     as_of_date AS release_date,
    body     updated_at,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_level,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_name(place_name, county_name, state_name, geo_id) AS geo_name,
    body     state_fips,
    body     county_fips,
    body     state_name,
    body     county_name,
    body     geo_latitude,
    body     geo_longitude,
    body     metric_code,
    body     metric_display_name,
    body     value,
    body     value_type,
    body     units,
    body     units AS unit,
    body     NULL::text AS seasonal_adjustment_status,
    body     dataset_code,
    body     dataset_code AS dataset,
    body     vintage_year,
    body     vintage_year::text AS vintage,
    body     margin_of_error,
    body     margin_of_error_pct
    body    FROM gold_census.rpt_acs_observations;

v gold_census.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT DISTINCT ON (variable.dataset_code, variable.variable_code) 'CENSUS_ACS'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     (variable.dataset_code || ':'::text) || variable.variable_code AS source_object_key,
    body     'variable'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     COALESCE(NULLIF(variable.variable_label, ''::text), variable.variable_code) AS metric_display_name,
    body     NULL::text AS units,
    body     variable.value_role AS measure_kind,
    body     COALESCE(served.valid_geo_grains, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY['ANNUAL'::text] AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_census', 'relation', 'fact_acs_observation', 'key', (variable.dataset_code || ':'::text) || variable.variable_code) AS physical_lineage,
    body     variable.updated_at::text AS source_watermark,
    body     NULL::uuid AS source_run_id,
    body     variable.updated_at AS publication_time,
    body     'U.S. Census Bureau American Community Survey'::text AS source_name,
    body     'official-statistics'::text AS source_type,
    body     table_definition.reference_url
    body    FROM gold_census.dim_acs_variable variable
    body      JOIN gold_census.dim_acs_table table_definition USING (acs_table_sk)
    body      LEFT JOIN ( SELECT latest.metric_code,
    body             array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_level) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_level))) AS valid_geo_grains
    body            FROM gold_census.mv_acs_latest latest
    body           GROUP BY latest.metric_code) served ON served.metric_code = ((('CENSUS_ACS:'::text || variable.dataset_code) || ':'::text) || variable.variable_code)
    body   ORDER BY variable.dataset_code, variable.variable_code, variable.vintage_year DESC, variable.updated_at DESC;

r gold_census.mv_acs_latest
    column source_code text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CENSUS_ACS'::text
    column observation_date date NOT NULL
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date NOT NULL
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
    column geo_id text NOT NULL
    column geo_level text NOT NULL
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column place_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column value numeric
    column dataset_code text NOT NULL
    column vintage_year integer NOT NULL
    column table_id text NOT NULL
    column table_title text
    column variable_code text NOT NULL
    column variable_label text
    column concept text
    column universe text
    column denominator_hint text
    column is_publishable_default boolean
    column estimate_value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'valid'::text
    column source_value text
    column capture_id uuid
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column margin_of_error_pct numeric
    column estimate_annotation text
    column moe_annotation text
    column value_type text
    column units text
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    index ix_mv_acs_latest_metric_geo CREATE INDEX ix_mv_acs_latest_metric_geo ON gold_census.mv_acs_latest USING btree (metric_code, geo_id)
    index ix_mv_acs_latest_source_metric CREATE INDEX ix_mv_acs_latest_source_metric ON gold_census.mv_acs_latest USING btree (source_code, metric_code)
    index ix_mv_acs_latest_vintage CREATE INDEX ix_mv_acs_latest_vintage ON gold_census.mv_acs_latest USING btree (dataset_code, vintage_year)
    index uq_mv_acs_latest CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_mv_acs_latest ON gold_census.mv_acs_latest USING btree (geo_id, dataset_code, vintage_year, variable_code, COALESCE(metric_code, ''::text))

p gold_census.rpt_acs_observations
    column source_code text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CENSUS_ACS'::text
    column observation_date date NOT NULL
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date NOT NULL
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
    column geo_id text NOT NULL
    column geo_level text NOT NULL
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column place_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column value numeric
    column dataset_code text NOT NULL
    column vintage_year integer NOT NULL
    column table_id text NOT NULL
    column table_title text
    column variable_code text NOT NULL
    column variable_label text
    column concept text
    column universe text
    column denominator_hint text
    column is_publishable_default boolean
    column estimate_value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'valid'::text
    column source_value text
    column capture_id uuid
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column margin_of_error_pct numeric
    column estimate_annotation text
    column moe_annotation text
    column value_type text
    column units text
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    constraint rpt_acs_observations_dataset_code_check CHECK ((dataset_code = ANY (ARRAY['acs1'::text, 'acs5'::text])))
    constraint rpt_acs_observations_published_value_check CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (estimate_value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint rpt_acs_observations_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'absent'::text, 'blank'::text, 'sentinel'::text, 'invalid'::text])))
    index ix_rpt_acs_latest_selection CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_acs_latest_selection ON ONLY gold_census.rpt_acs_observations USING btree (geo_id, variable_code, metric_code, observation_date DESC, updated_at DESC, (
CASE dataset_code
    WHEN 'acs1'::text THEN 1
    WHEN 'acs5'::text THEN 2
    ELSE 9
END), vintage_year DESC)
    index ix_rpt_acs_observations_dataset_vintage CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_acs_observations_dataset_vintage ON ONLY gold_census.rpt_acs_observations USING btree (dataset_code, vintage_year)
    index ix_rpt_acs_observations_metric_date CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_acs_observations_metric_date ON ONLY gold_census.rpt_acs_observations USING btree (metric_code, observation_date)
    index ix_rpt_acs_observations_metric_geo_date CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_acs_observations_metric_geo_date ON ONLY gold_census.rpt_acs_observations USING btree (metric_code, geo_id, observation_date)
    index ix_rpt_acs_observations_metric_vintage CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_acs_observations_metric_vintage ON ONLY gold_census.rpt_acs_observations USING btree (metric_code, vintage_year, as_of_date)
    index ix_rpt_acs_observations_source_geo_date CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_acs_observations_source_geo_date ON ONLY gold_census.rpt_acs_observations USING btree (source_code, geo_id, observation_date)
    index ix_rpt_acs_observations_updated_at CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_acs_observations_updated_at ON ONLY gold_census.rpt_acs_observations USING btree (updated_at DESC)
    index uq_rpt_acs_observations_nk CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_rpt_acs_observations_nk ON ONLY gold_census.rpt_acs_observations USING btree (geo_id, observation_date, dataset_code, vintage_year, variable_code, COALESCE(metric_code, ''::text))
    partitioned by RANGE (observation_date)
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2000 FOR VALUES FROM ('2000-01-01') TO ('2001-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2001 FOR VALUES FROM ('2001-01-01') TO ('2002-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2002 FOR VALUES FROM ('2002-01-01') TO ('2003-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2003 FOR VALUES FROM ('2003-01-01') TO ('2004-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2004 FOR VALUES FROM ('2004-01-01') TO ('2005-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2005 FOR VALUES FROM ('2005-01-01') TO ('2006-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2006 FOR VALUES FROM ('2006-01-01') TO ('2007-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2007 FOR VALUES FROM ('2007-01-01') TO ('2008-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2008 FOR VALUES FROM ('2008-01-01') TO ('2009-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2009 FOR VALUES FROM ('2009-01-01') TO ('2010-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2010 FOR VALUES FROM ('2010-01-01') TO ('2011-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2011 FOR VALUES FROM ('2011-01-01') TO ('2012-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2012 FOR VALUES FROM ('2012-01-01') TO ('2013-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2013 FOR VALUES FROM ('2013-01-01') TO ('2014-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2014 FOR VALUES FROM ('2014-01-01') TO ('2015-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2015 FOR VALUES FROM ('2015-01-01') TO ('2016-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2016 FOR VALUES FROM ('2016-01-01') TO ('2017-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2017 FOR VALUES FROM ('2017-01-01') TO ('2018-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2018 FOR VALUES FROM ('2018-01-01') TO ('2019-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2019 FOR VALUES FROM ('2019-01-01') TO ('2020-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2020 FOR VALUES FROM ('2020-01-01') TO ('2021-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2021 FOR VALUES FROM ('2021-01-01') TO ('2022-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2022 FOR VALUES FROM ('2022-01-01') TO ('2023-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2023 FOR VALUES FROM ('2023-01-01') TO ('2024-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2024 FOR VALUES FROM ('2024-01-01') TO ('2025-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2025 FOR VALUES FROM ('2025-01-01') TO ('2026-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2026 FOR VALUES FROM ('2026-01-01') TO ('2027-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2027 FOR VALUES FROM ('2027-01-01') TO ('2028-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2028 FOR VALUES FROM ('2028-01-01') TO ('2029-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2029 FOR VALUES FROM ('2029-01-01') TO ('2030-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2030 FOR VALUES FROM ('2030-01-01') TO ('2031-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2031 FOR VALUES FROM ('2031-01-01') TO ('2032-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2032 FOR VALUES FROM ('2032-01-01') TO ('2033-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2033 FOR VALUES FROM ('2033-01-01') TO ('2034-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2034 FOR VALUES FROM ('2034-01-01') TO ('2035-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2035 FOR VALUES FROM ('2035-01-01') TO ('2036-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_unranged DEFAULT

v gold_census.v_metric_latest_by_geo
    column source_code text
    column source text
    column observation_date date
    column period text
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date
    column release_date date
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone
    column geo_id text
    column geo_level text
    column geo_name text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    column value numeric
    column value_type text
    column units text
    column unit text
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column dataset_code text
    column dataset text
    column vintage_year integer
    column vintage text
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column margin_of_error_pct numeric
    body SELECT source_code,
    body     source_code AS source,
    body     observation_date,
    body     observation_date::text AS period,
    body     duration_start,
    body     duration_end,
    body     time_sk,
    body     as_of_date,
    body     as_of_date AS release_date,
    body     updated_at,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_level,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_name(place_name, county_name, state_name, geo_id) AS geo_name,
    body     state_fips,
    body     county_fips,
    body     state_name,
    body     county_name,
    body     geo_latitude,
    body     geo_longitude,
    body     metric_code,
    body     metric_display_name,
    body     value,
    body     value_type,
    body     units,
    body     units AS unit,
    body     NULL::text AS seasonal_adjustment_status,
    body     dataset_code,
    body     dataset_code AS dataset,
    body     vintage_year,
    body     vintage_year::text AS vintage,
    body     margin_of_error,
    body     margin_of_error_pct
    body    FROM gold_census.mv_acs_latest;

    column state_name text
    column county_name text

    column geo_longitude double precision

v gold_fbi.agency_geography
    column relationship_sk bigint
    column ori text
    column state_code text
    column agency_name text
    column agency_type text
    column county_labels text[]
    column relationship_type text
    column source_label text
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column resolution_method text
    column resolution_status text
    column confidence_class text
    column reason_code text
    column effective_start date
    column effective_end date
    column geography_vintage integer
    column evidence_source text
    column evidence_capture_id uuid
    column release_key text
    column agency_geo_sk bigint
    body SELECT relationship.relationship_sk,
    body     relationship.ori,
    body     agency.state_code,
    body     version.agency_name,
    body     version.agency_type,
    body     version.county_labels,
    body     relationship.relationship_type,
    body     relationship.source_label,
    body     relationship.geo_id,
    body     relationship.geo_sk,
    body     relationship.resolution_method,
    body     relationship.resolution_status,
    body     relationship.confidence_class,
    body     relationship.reason_code,
    body     relationship.effective_start,
    body     relationship.effective_end,
    body     relationship.geography_vintage,
    body     relationship.evidence_source,
    body     relationship.evidence_capture_id,
    body     relationship.release_key,
    body     agency.geo_sk AS agency_geo_sk
    body    FROM silver_fbi.agency_geography_relationship relationship
    body      JOIN silver_fbi.dim_agency agency USING (ori)
    body      JOIN silver_fbi.dim_agency_version version ON version.ori = relationship.ori AND version.release_key = relationship.release_key
    body      JOIN silver_fbi.dim_ucr_dataset_release release ON release.product_id = relationship.product_id AND release.release_key = relationship.release_key
    body   WHERE release.status = 'published'::text;

v gold_fbi.agency_observation_area_filter
    column observation_sk bigint
    column product_id text
    column release_key text
    column measure_id text
    column measure_form text
    column counted_entity_basis text
    column unit text
    column ori text
    column agency_name text
    column period text
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column participation_status text
    column coverage_percent numeric
    column filter_geography_type text
    column filter_geo_id text
    column filter_geo_sk bigint
    column filter_source_label text
    column filter_confidence_class text
    column result_label text
    column observation_grain text
    body SELECT observation.observation_sk,
    body     observation.product_id,
    body     observation.release_key,
    body     observation.measure_id,
    body     observation.measure_form,
    body     observation.counted_entity_basis,
    body     observation.unit,
    body     observation.subject_code AS ori,
    body     observation.subject_label AS agency_name,
    body     observation.period,
    body     observation.period_start,
    body     observation.period_end,
    body     observation.value,
    body     observation.value_status,
    body     observation.participation_status,
    body     observation.coverage_percent,
    body     relationship.relationship_type AS filter_geography_type,
    body     relationship.geo_id AS filter_geo_id,
    body     relationship.geo_sk AS filter_geo_sk,
    body     relationship.source_label AS filter_source_label,
    body     relationship.confidence_class AS filter_confidence_class,
    body         CASE relationship.relationship_type
    body             WHEN 'county'::text THEN 'agency-reported for agencies associated with this county'::text
    body             WHEN 'place'::text THEN 'agency-reported for agencies mapped to this place'::text
    body             ELSE 'agency-reported for agencies associated with this state'::text
    body         END AS result_label,
    body     'agency'::text AS observation_grain
    body    FROM gold_fbi.crime_observation observation
    body      JOIN silver_fbi.agency_geography_relationship relationship ON relationship.ori = observation.subject_code AND relationship.product_id = observation.product_id AND observation.period_start >= relationship.effective_start AND observation.period_end <= relationship.effective_end
    body   WHERE observation.subject_type = 'agency'::text AND relationship.resolution_status = 'resolved'::text;

v gold_fbi.crime_observation
    column observation_sk bigint
    column product_id text
    column offense_code text
    column offense_label text
    column ucr_program text
    column release_key text
    column refresh_date date
    column max_data_month text
    column measure_id text
    column measure_form text
    column counted_entity_basis text
    column unit text
    column reported_status text
    column subject_type text
    column subject_code text
    column subject_label text
    column source_geo_level text
    column period text
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geography_status text
    column geography_basis text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column population_denominator numeric
    column population numeric
    column participated_population numeric
    column coverage_percent numeric
    column coverage_basis text
    column participation_status text
    column counted_entity_note text
    column methodology_url text
    column documentation_url text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    body SELECT fact.observation_sk,
    body     fact.product_id,
    body     release.offense_code,
    body     release.offense_label,
    body     release.ucr_program,
    body     fact.release_key,
    body     release.refresh_date,
    body     release.max_data_month,
    body     fact.measure_id,
    body     measure.measure_form,
    body     measure.counted_entity_basis,
    body     measure.unit,
    body     measure.reported_status,
    body     fact.subject_type,
    body     fact.subject_code,
    body     fact.subject_label,
    body     fact.source_geo_level,
    body     fact.period,
    body     fact.period_start,
    body     fact.period_end,
    body     fact.geo_id,
    body     fact.geo_sk,
    body     fact.geography_status,
    body         CASE fact.subject_type
    body             WHEN 'national'::text THEN 'provider-published national total'::text
    body             WHEN 'state'::text THEN 'provider-published state total'::text
    body             ELSE 'agency-reported for one law-enforcement agency'::text
    body         END AS geography_basis,
    body     fact.value_source,
    body     fact.value,
    body     fact.value_status,
    body     fact.population_denominator,
    body     coverage.population,
    body     coverage.participated_population,
    body     coverage.coverage_percent,
    body     coverage.coverage_basis,
    body     coverage.participation_status,
    body     release.counted_entity_note,
    body     release.methodology_url,
    body     release.documentation_url,
    body     fact.source_record_id,
    body     fact.capture_id
    body    FROM silver_fbi.fact_crime_observation fact
    body      JOIN silver_fbi.dim_ucr_dataset_release release ON release.product_id = fact.product_id AND release.release_key = fact.release_key
    body      JOIN silver_fbi.dim_offense_measure measure ON measure.product_id = fact.product_id AND measure.measure_id = fact.measure_id
    body      JOIN silver_fbi.fact_reporting_participation coverage ON coverage.product_id = fact.product_id AND coverage.release_key = fact.release_key AND coverage.subject_type = fact.subject_type AND coverage.subject_code = fact.subject_code AND coverage.period = fact.period
    body   WHERE release.status = 'published'::text AND (fact.geography_status <> ALL (ARRAY['ambiguous'::text, 'unsupported'::text]));

v gold_fbi.latest_release_observation
    column observation_sk bigint
    column product_id text
    column offense_code text
    column offense_label text
    column ucr_program text
    column release_key text
    column refresh_date date
    column max_data_month text
    column measure_id text
    column measure_form text
    column counted_entity_basis text
    column unit text
    column reported_status text
    column subject_type text
    column subject_code text
    column subject_label text
    column source_geo_level text
    column period text
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geography_status text
    column geography_basis text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column population_denominator numeric
    column population numeric
    column participated_population numeric
    column coverage_percent numeric
    column coverage_basis text
    column participation_status text
    column counted_entity_note text
    column methodology_url text
    column documentation_url text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    body SELECT observation.observation_sk,
    body     observation.product_id,
    body     observation.offense_code,
    body     observation.offense_label,
    body     observation.ucr_program,
    body     observation.release_key,
    body     observation.refresh_date,
    body     observation.max_data_month,
    body     observation.measure_id,
    body     observation.measure_form,
    body     observation.counted_entity_basis,
    body     observation.unit,
    body     observation.reported_status,
    body     observation.subject_type,
    body     observation.subject_code,
    body     observation.subject_label,
    body     observation.source_geo_level,
    body     observation.period,
    body     observation.period_start,
    body     observation.period_end,
    body     observation.geo_id,
    body     observation.geo_sk,
    body     observation.geography_status,
    body     observation.geography_basis,
    body     observation.value_source,
    body     observation.value,
    body     observation.value_status,
    body     observation.population_denominator,
    body     observation.population,
    body     observation.participated_population,
    body     observation.coverage_percent,
    body     observation.coverage_basis,
    body     observation.participation_status,
    body     observation.counted_entity_note,
    body     observation.methodology_url,
    body     observation.documentation_url,
    body     observation.source_record_id,
    body     observation.capture_id
    body    FROM gold_fbi.crime_observation observation
    body      JOIN ( SELECT dim_ucr_dataset_release.product_id,
    body             max(dim_ucr_dataset_release.refresh_date) AS refresh_date
    body            FROM silver_fbi.dim_ucr_dataset_release
    body           WHERE dim_ucr_dataset_release.status = 'published'::text
    body           GROUP BY dim_ucr_dataset_release.product_id) latest ON latest.product_id = observation.product_id AND latest.refresh_date = observation.refresh_date;

v gold_fbi.measure_export
    column source_dataset text
    column source_measure_code text
    column source_offense_code text
    column display_name text
    column ucr_program text
    column measure_form text
    column counted_entity_basis text
    column unit text
    column reported_status text
    column source_watermark text
    column methodology_url text
    column counted_entity_note text
    column schema_version text
    body SELECT measure.product_id AS source_dataset,
    body     measure.measure_id AS source_measure_code,
    body     measure.offense_code AS source_offense_code,
    body     measure.offense_label AS display_name,
    body     measure.ucr_program,
    body     measure.measure_form,
    body     measure.counted_entity_basis,
    body     measure.unit,
    body     measure.reported_status,
    body     release.release_key AS source_watermark,
    body     release.methodology_url,
    body     release.counted_entity_note,
    body     release.parser_contract_version AS schema_version
    body    FROM silver_fbi.dim_offense_measure measure
    body      JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT candidate.product_id,
    body             candidate.release_key,
    body             candidate.refresh_date,
    body             candidate.max_data_month,
    body             candidate.ucr_program,
    body             candidate.offense_code,
    body             candidate.offense_label,
    body             candidate.period_start,
    body             candidate.period_end,
    body             candidate.documentation_url,
    body             candidate.methodology_url,
    body             candidate.parser_contract_version,
    body             candidate.reported_status,
    body             candidate.counted_entity_note,
    body             candidate.release_capture_id,
    body             candidate.source_run_id,
    body             candidate.source_record_count,
    body             candidate.quarantine_count,
    body             candidate.status,
    body             candidate.reconciled_at,
    body             candidate.published_at,
    body             candidate.created_at,
    body             candidate.updated_at
    body            FROM silver_fbi.dim_ucr_dataset_release candidate
    body           WHERE candidate.product_id = measure.product_id AND candidate.status = 'published'::text
    body           ORDER BY candidate.refresh_date DESC
    body          LIMIT 1) release ON true;

v gold_fbi.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'FBI_UCR'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     (measure.product_id || ':'::text) || measure.measure_id AS source_object_key,
    body     'measure'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     ((((measure.offense_label || ' '::text) || measure.counted_entity_basis) || ' ('::text) || measure.measure_form) || ')'::text AS metric_display_name,
    body     measure.unit AS units,
    body     'source_fact'::text AS measure_kind,
    body     measure.valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY['MONTHLY'::text] AS valid_time_grains,
    body         CASE
    body             WHEN measure.measure_form = 'absolute_total'::text THEN 'additive_within_subject'::text
    body             ELSE 'non_additive'::text
    body         END AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_fbi', 'relation', 'crime_observation', 'product_id', measure.product_id, 'measure_id', measure.measure_id) AS physical_lineage,
    body     release.release_key AS source_watermark,
    body     release.source_run_id,
    body     release.published_at AS publication_time,
    body     'Federal Bureau of Investigation Uniform Crime Reporting Program'::text AS source_name,
    body     'government-law-enforcement'::text AS source_type,
    body     release.methodology_url AS reference_url
    body    FROM ( SELECT measure_1.product_id,
    body             measure_1.measure_id,
    body             measure_1.offense_label,
    body             measure_1.counted_entity_basis,
    body             measure_1.measure_form,
    body             measure_1.unit,
    body             array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(fact.subject_type) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(fact.subject_type))) AS valid_geo_grains
    body            FROM silver_fbi.dim_offense_measure measure_1
    body              JOIN silver_fbi.fact_crime_observation fact ON fact.product_id = measure_1.product_id AND fact.measure_id = measure_1.measure_id
    body              JOIN silver_fbi.dim_ucr_dataset_release release_1 ON release_1.product_id = fact.product_id AND release_1.release_key = fact.release_key
    body           WHERE release_1.status = 'published'::text AND (fact.geography_status <> ALL (ARRAY['ambiguous'::text, 'unsupported'::text]))
    body           GROUP BY measure_1.product_id, measure_1.measure_id, measure_1.offense_label, measure_1.counted_entity_basis, measure_1.measure_form, measure_1.unit) measure
    body      JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT candidate.product_id,
    body             candidate.release_key,
    body             candidate.refresh_date,
    body             candidate.max_data_month,
    body             candidate.ucr_program,
    body             candidate.offense_code,
    body             candidate.offense_label,
    body             candidate.period_start,
    body             candidate.period_end,
    body             candidate.documentation_url,
    body             candidate.methodology_url,
    body             candidate.parser_contract_version,
    body             candidate.reported_status,
    body             candidate.counted_entity_note,
    body             candidate.release_capture_id,
    body             candidate.source_run_id,
    body             candidate.source_record_count,
    body             candidate.quarantine_count,
    body             candidate.status,
    body             candidate.reconciled_at,
    body             candidate.published_at,
    body             candidate.created_at,
    body             candidate.updated_at
    body            FROM silver_fbi.dim_ucr_dataset_release candidate
    body           WHERE candidate.product_id = measure.product_id AND candidate.status = 'published'::text
    body           ORDER BY candidate.refresh_date DESC
    body          LIMIT 1) release ON true;

v gold_fbi.reporting_coverage
    column participation_sk bigint
    column product_id text
    column release_key text
    column ucr_program text
    column subject_type text
    column subject_code text
    column subject_label text
    column source_geo_level text
    column period text
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geography_status text
    column population numeric
    column participated_population numeric
    column coverage_percent numeric
    column coverage_basis text
    column participation_status text
    column refresh_date date
    column methodology_url text
    column capture_id uuid
    body SELECT coverage.participation_sk,
    body     coverage.product_id,
    body     coverage.release_key,
    body     coverage.ucr_program,
    body     coverage.subject_type,
    body     coverage.subject_code,
    body     coverage.subject_label,
    body     coverage.source_geo_level,
    body     coverage.period,
    body     coverage.period_start,
    body     coverage.period_end,
    body     coverage.geo_id,
    body     coverage.geo_sk,
    body     coverage.geography_status,
    body     coverage.population,
    body     coverage.participated_population,
    body     coverage.coverage_percent,
    body     coverage.coverage_basis,
    body     coverage.participation_status,
    body     release.refresh_date,
    body     release.methodology_url,
    body     coverage.capture_id
    body    FROM silver_fbi.fact_reporting_participation coverage
    body      JOIN silver_fbi.dim_ucr_dataset_release release ON release.product_id = coverage.product_id AND release.release_key = coverage.release_key
    body   WHERE release.status = 'published'::text;

r gold_fred.dim_fred_series
    column fred_series_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('gold_fred.dim_fred_series_fred_series_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column series_id text NOT NULL
    column series_title text
    column source_provider text
    column original_source_name text
    column is_primary_source_series boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
    column is_republished_series boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
    column frequency text
    column units text
    column seasonal_adjustment text
    column transformation_method text
    column realtime_available boolean
    column lineage_notes text
    column reference_url text
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint dim_fred_series_pkey PRIMARY KEY (fred_series_sk)
    constraint dim_fred_series_series_id_key UNIQUE (series_id)
    index dim_fred_series_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_fred_series_pkey ON gold_fred.dim_fred_series USING btree (fred_series_sk)
    index dim_fred_series_series_id_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_fred_series_series_id_key ON gold_fred.dim_fred_series USING btree (series_id)

v gold_fred.fact_fred_observation
    column geo_id text
    column geo_level text
    column time_sk integer
    column observation_date date
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column fred_series_sk bigint
    column value numeric
    column realtime_start date
    column realtime_end date
    column frequency character varying(50)
    column units character varying(255)
    column seasonal_adjustment character varying(50)
    column transform_applied text
    column source_provider text
    column as_of_date date
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone
    body SELECT 'us:1'::text AS geo_id,
    body     'NATIONAL'::text AS geo_level,
    body     s.time_sk,
    body     s.observation_date,
    body     s.duration_start,
    body     s.duration_end,
    body     fs.fred_series_sk,
    body     s.value,
    body     s.realtime_start,
    body     s.realtime_end,
    body     s.frequency,
    body     s.unit_of_measure AS units,
    body     s.seasonal_adjustment,
    body     NULL::text AS transform_applied,
    body     'FRED'::text AS source_provider,
    body     s.ingested_at::date AS as_of_date,
    body     s.ingested_at AS updated_at
    body    FROM silver_fred.fact_economic_indicators s
    body      JOIN gold_fred.dim_fred_series fs ON fs.series_id = s.series_id::text
    body   WHERE s.is_missing = false AND s.series_id IS NOT NULL AND s.series_id::text <> ''::text;

v gold_fred.fact_observation
    column source_code text
    column source text
    column observation_date date
    column period text
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date
    column release_date date
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone
    column geo_id text
    column geo_level text
    column geo_name text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    column value numeric
    column value_type text
    column units text
    column unit text
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column dataset_code text
    column dataset text
    column vintage_year integer
    column vintage text
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column margin_of_error_pct numeric
    body SELECT source_code,
    body     source_code AS source,
    body     observation_date,
    body     observation_date::text AS period,
    body     duration_start,
    body     duration_end,
    body     time_sk,
    body     as_of_date,
    body     as_of_date AS release_date,
    body     updated_at,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_level,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_name(place_name, county_name, state_name, geo_id) AS geo_name,
    body     state_fips,
    body     county_fips,
    body     state_name,
    body     county_name,
    body     geo_latitude,
    body     geo_longitude,
    body     metric_code,
    body     metric_display_name,
    body     value,
    body     value_type,
    body     units,
    body     units AS unit,
    body     seasonal_adjustment_status,
    body     'fred'::text AS dataset_code,
    body     'fred'::text AS dataset,
    body     NULL::integer AS vintage_year,
    body     NULL::text AS vintage,
    body     NULL::numeric AS margin_of_error,
    body     NULL::numeric AS margin_of_error_pct
    body    FROM gold_fred.rpt_fred_observations;

v gold_fred.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'FRED'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     series.series_id AS source_object_key,
    body     'series'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     COALESCE(NULLIF(series.series_title, ''::text), series.series_id) AS metric_display_name,
    body     series.units,
    body     NULL::text AS measure_kind,
    body     COALESCE(served.valid_geo_grains, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body         CASE
    body             WHEN lower(COALESCE(series.frequency, ''::text)) ~~ '%daily%'::text THEN ARRAY['DAILY'::text]
    body             WHEN lower(COALESCE(series.frequency, ''::text)) ~~ '%weekly%'::text THEN ARRAY['WEEKLY'::text]
    body             WHEN lower(COALESCE(series.frequency, ''::text)) ~~ '%quarter%'::text THEN ARRAY['QUARTERLY'::text]
    body             WHEN lower(COALESCE(series.frequency, ''::text)) ~~ '%annual%'::text THEN ARRAY['ANNUAL'::text]
    body             ELSE ARRAY['MONTHLY'::text]
    body         END AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_fred', 'relation', 'fact_fred_observation', 'key', series.series_id) AS physical_lineage,
    body     COALESCE(max(fact.updated_at), series.updated_at)::text AS source_watermark,
    body     NULL::uuid AS source_run_id,
    body     COALESCE(max(fact.updated_at), series.updated_at) AS publication_time,
    body     'Federal Reserve Economic Data'::text AS source_name,
    body     'economic-data-aggregator'::text AS source_type,
    body     series.reference_url
    body    FROM gold_fred.dim_fred_series series
    body      LEFT JOIN gold_fred.fact_fred_observation fact ON fact.fred_series_sk = series.fred_series_sk
    body      LEFT JOIN ( SELECT latest.metric_code,
    body             array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_level) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_level))) AS valid_geo_grains
    body            FROM gold_fred.mv_fred_latest latest
    body           GROUP BY latest.metric_code) served ON served.metric_code = ('FRED:'::text || series.series_id)
    body   GROUP BY series.fred_series_sk, served.valid_geo_grains;

r gold_fred.mv_fred_latest
    column source_code text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'FRED'::text
    column observation_date date NOT NULL
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date NOT NULL
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
    column geo_id text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'us:1'::text
    column geo_level text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NATIONAL'::text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column place_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column series_id text NOT NULL
    column series_title text
    column value numeric NOT NULL
    column value_type text
    column units text
    column frequency text
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column source_provider text
    column original_source_name text
    column is_primary_source_series boolean
    column is_republished_series boolean
    column transformation_method text
    column realtime_start date
    column realtime_end date
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    index ix_mv_fred_latest_metric_geo CREATE INDEX ix_mv_fred_latest_metric_geo ON gold_fred.mv_fred_latest USING btree (metric_code, geo_id)
    index ix_mv_fred_latest_observation_date CREATE INDEX ix_mv_fred_latest_observation_date ON gold_fred.mv_fred_latest USING btree (observation_date)
    index ix_mv_fred_latest_source_metric CREATE INDEX ix_mv_fred_latest_source_metric ON gold_fred.mv_fred_latest USING btree (source_code, metric_code)
    index uq_mv_fred_latest CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_mv_fred_latest ON gold_fred.mv_fred_latest USING btree (series_id, COALESCE(metric_code, ''::text), COALESCE(realtime_start, '0001-01-01'::date), COALESCE(realtime_end, '0001-01-01'::date))

r gold_fred.rpt_fred_observations
    column source_code text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'FRED'::text
    column observation_date date NOT NULL
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date NOT NULL
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
    column geo_id text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'us:1'::text
    column geo_level text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NATIONAL'::text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column place_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column series_id text NOT NULL
    column series_title text
    column value numeric NOT NULL
    column value_type text
    column units text
    column frequency text
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column source_provider text
    column original_source_name text
    column is_primary_source_series boolean
    column is_republished_series boolean
    column transformation_method text
    column realtime_start date
    column realtime_end date
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    index ix_rpt_fred_latest_selection CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_fred_latest_selection ON gold_fred.rpt_fred_observations USING btree (series_id, metric_code, observation_date DESC, realtime_start DESC NULLS LAST, realtime_end DESC NULLS LAST, updated_at DESC)
    index ix_rpt_fred_observations_metric_date CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_fred_observations_metric_date ON gold_fred.rpt_fred_observations USING btree (metric_code, observation_date)
    index ix_rpt_fred_observations_metric_geo_date CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_fred_observations_metric_geo_date ON gold_fred.rpt_fred_observations USING btree (metric_code, geo_id, observation_date)
    index ix_rpt_fred_observations_series_date CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_fred_observations_series_date ON gold_fred.rpt_fred_observations USING btree (series_id, observation_date)
    index ix_rpt_fred_observations_updated_at CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_fred_observations_updated_at ON gold_fred.rpt_fred_observations USING btree (updated_at DESC)
    index uq_rpt_fred_observations_nk CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_rpt_fred_observations_nk ON gold_fred.rpt_fred_observations USING btree (observation_date, series_id, COALESCE(metric_code, ''::text), COALESCE(realtime_start, '0001-01-01'::date), COALESCE(realtime_end, '0001-01-01'::date))

v gold_fred.v_metric_latest_by_geo
    column source_code text
    column source text
    column observation_date date
    column period text
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date
    column release_date date
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone
    column geo_id text
    column geo_level text
    column geo_name text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    column value numeric
    column value_type text
    column units text
    column unit text
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column dataset_code text
    column dataset text
    column vintage_year integer
    column vintage text
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column margin_of_error_pct numeric
    body SELECT source_code,
    body     source_code AS source,
    body     observation_date,
    body     observation_date::text AS period,
    body     duration_start,
    body     duration_end,
    body     time_sk,
    body     as_of_date,
    body     as_of_date AS release_date,
    body     updated_at,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_level,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_name(place_name, county_name, state_name, geo_id) AS geo_name,
    body     state_fips,
    body     county_fips,
    body     state_name,
    body     county_name,
    body     geo_latitude,
    body     geo_longitude,
    body     metric_code,
    body     metric_display_name,
    body     value,
    body     value_type,
    body     units,
    body     units AS unit,
    body     seasonal_adjustment_status,
    body     'fred'::text AS dataset_code,
    body     'fred'::text AS dataset,
    body     NULL::integer AS vintage_year,
    body     NULL::text AS vintage,
    body     NULL::numeric AS margin_of_error,
    body     NULL::numeric AS margin_of_error_pct
    body    FROM gold_fred.mv_fred_latest;

v gold_fred.v_metric_timeseries_by_geo
    column source_code text
    column source text
    column observation_date date
    column period text
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date
    column release_date date
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone
    column geo_id text
    column geo_level text
    column geo_name text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    column value numeric
    column value_type text
    column units text
    column unit text
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column dataset_code text
    column dataset text
    column vintage_year integer
    column vintage text
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column margin_of_error_pct numeric
    body SELECT source_code,
    body     source,
    body     observation_date,
    body     period,
    body     duration_start,
    body     duration_end,
    body     time_sk,
    body     as_of_date,
    body     release_date,
    body     updated_at,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_level,
    body     geo_name,
    body     state_fips,
    body     county_fips,
    body     state_name,
    body     county_name,
    body     geo_latitude,
    body     geo_longitude,
    body     metric_code,
    body     metric_display_name,
    body     value,
    body     value_type,
    body     units,
    body     unit,
    body     seasonal_adjustment_status,
    body     dataset_code,
    body     dataset,
    body     vintage_year,
    body     vintage,
    body     margin_of_error,
    body     margin_of_error_pct
    body    FROM gold_fred.fact_observation;

r gold_glossary.dim_geo_latest
    column geo_id text NOT NULL
    column geo_level text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column place_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column place_name text
    column latitude double precision
    column longitude double precision
    column geo_geom geometry(MultiPolygon,4326)
    column boundary_vintage integer
    column geography_state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'current'::text
    column retired_at timestamp with time zone
    column refreshed_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint ck_dim_geo_latest_geography_state CHECK ((geography_state = ANY (ARRAY['current'::text, 'retired'::text])))
    constraint dim_geo_latest_pkey PRIMARY KEY (geo_id)
    index dim_geo_latest_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_geo_latest_pkey ON gold_glossary.dim_geo_latest USING btree (geo_id)
    index ix_gold_glossary_dim_geo_latest_geom CREATE INDEX ix_gold_glossary_dim_geo_latest_geom ON gold_glossary.dim_geo_latest USING gist (geo_geom)
    index ix_gold_glossary_dim_geo_latest_state CREATE INDEX ix_gold_glossary_dim_geo_latest_state ON gold_glossary.dim_geo_latest USING btree (geography_state)

v gold_glossary.dim_geography
    column geo_id text
    column geo_level text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column place_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column place_name text
    column latitude double precision
    column longitude double precision
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column boundary_vintage integer
    column refreshed_at timestamp with time zone
    column geo_name text
    column geography_state text
    column retired_at timestamp with time zone
    column is_active boolean
    body SELECT geo_id,
    body     geo_level,
    body     state_fips,
    body     county_fips,
    body     place_fips,
    body     state_name,
    body     county_name,
    body     place_name,
    body     latitude,
    body     longitude,
    body     latitude AS geo_latitude,
    body     longitude AS geo_longitude,
    body     boundary_vintage,
    body     refreshed_at,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_name(place_name, county_name, state_name, geo_id) AS geo_name,
    body     geography_state,
    body     retired_at,
    body     geography_state = 'current'::text AS is_active
    body    FROM gold_glossary.dim_geo_latest;

v gold_glossary.dim_metric
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    column source_code text
    column source_object_type text
    column source_object_key text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid

    column harvested_at timestamp with time zone
    column freshness_state text

    body     source_object_type,

    body     measure_kind,
    body     valid_geo_grains,
    body     valid_time_grains,
    body     aggregation_characteristic,
    body     physical_lineage,
    body     publisher_contract_version,
    body     source_watermark,
    body     source_run_id,
    body     publication_time,
    body     harvested_at,
    body     freshness_state,
    body     freshness_state = 'current'::text AS is_active
