r gold_glossary.dim_metric_catalog
    column metric_catalog_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('gold_glossary.dim_metric_catalog_metric_catalog_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column metric_code text NOT NULL
    column source_code text NOT NULL
    column source_object_type text NOT NULL
    column source_object_key text
    column metric_display_name text NOT NULL
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT ARRAY[]::text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT ARRAY[]::text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column harvested_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column freshness_state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'current'::text
    column missing_harvest_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    constraint dim_metric_catalog_freshness_state_check CHECK ((freshness_state = ANY (ARRAY['current'::text, 'stale'::text, 'retired'::text])))
    constraint dim_metric_catalog_metric_code_key UNIQUE (metric_code)
    constraint dim_metric_catalog_missing_harvest_count_check CHECK ((missing_harvest_count >= 0))
    constraint dim_metric_catalog_pkey PRIMARY KEY (metric_catalog_sk)
    constraint dim_metric_catalog_source_code_fkey FOREIGN KEY (source_code) REFERENCES gold_glossary.dim_source_system(source_code)
    constraint dim_metric_catalog_source_code_source_object_type_source_ob_key UNIQUE (source_code, source_object_type, source_object_key)
    index dim_metric_catalog_metric_code_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_metric_catalog_metric_code_key ON gold_glossary.dim_metric_catalog USING btree (metric_code)
    index dim_metric_catalog_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_metric_catalog_pkey ON gold_glossary.dim_metric_catalog USING btree (metric_catalog_sk)
    index dim_metric_catalog_source_code_source_object_type_source_ob_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_metric_catalog_source_code_source_object_type_source_ob_key ON gold_glossary.dim_metric_catalog USING btree (source_code, source_object_type, source_object_key)
    index metric_catalog_source_freshness_idx CREATE INDEX metric_catalog_source_freshness_idx ON gold_glossary.dim_metric_catalog USING btree (source_code, freshness_state)

r gold_glossary.dim_source_system
    column source_system_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('gold_glossary.dim_source_system_source_system_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column source_code text NOT NULL
    column source_name text NOT NULL
    column source_type text NOT NULL
    column reference_url text
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column first_harvested_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column last_harvested_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint dim_source_system_pkey PRIMARY KEY (source_system_sk)
    constraint dim_source_system_source_code_key UNIQUE (source_code)
    index dim_source_system_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_source_system_pkey ON gold_glossary.dim_source_system USING btree (source_system_sk)
    index dim_source_system_source_code_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_source_system_source_code_key ON gold_glossary.dim_source_system USING btree (source_code)

r gold_glossary.publisher_harvest_state
    column source_code text NOT NULL
    column publisher_contract_version text NOT NULL
    column last_source_watermark text
    column last_source_run_id uuid
    column last_publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column last_harvest_started_at timestamp with time zone
    column last_harvest_completed_at timestamp with time zone
    column status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'::text
    column last_error text
    column last_content_fingerprint text
    column last_harvest_forced boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
    constraint publisher_harvest_state_pkey PRIMARY KEY (source_code)
    constraint publisher_harvest_state_source_code_fkey FOREIGN KEY (source_code) REFERENCES gold_glossary.dim_source_system(source_code)
    constraint publisher_harvest_state_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'running'::text, 'success'::text, 'failed'::text, 'stale'::text])))
    index publisher_harvest_state_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX publisher_harvest_state_pkey ON gold_glossary.publisher_harvest_state USING btree (source_code)

r gold_glossary.publisher_registry
    column source_code text NOT NULL
    column publisher_schema text NOT NULL
    column publisher_view text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'metric_publisher'::text
    column publisher_contract_version text NOT NULL
    column discovery_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'::text
    column last_discovered_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column last_error text
    constraint publisher_registry_discovery_status_check CHECK ((discovery_status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'invalid'::text, 'unavailable'::text, 'retired'::text])))
    constraint publisher_registry_pkey PRIMARY KEY (source_code)
    constraint publisher_registry_publisher_schema_publisher_view_key UNIQUE (publisher_schema, publisher_view)
    index publisher_registry_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX publisher_registry_pkey ON gold_glossary.publisher_registry USING btree (source_code)
    index publisher_registry_publisher_schema_publisher_view_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX publisher_registry_publisher_schema_publisher_view_key ON gold_glossary.publisher_registry USING btree (publisher_schema, publisher_view)

v gold_nass.crop_observation
    column observation_sk bigint
    column product_id text
    column product_label text
    column release_watermark text
    column slice_mode text
    column source_desc text
    column sector_desc text
    column group_desc text
    column commodity_desc text
    column class_desc text
    column prodn_practice_desc text
    column util_practice_desc text
    column commodity_sk text
    column statisticcat_desc text
    column short_desc text
    column unit_desc text
    column freq_desc text
    column value_kind text
    column calculation_basis text
    column additive_behavior text
    column additive_behavior_known boolean
    column statistic_sk text
    column domain_desc text
    column domaincat_desc text
    column domain_sk text
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geography_status text
    column geo_source_code text
    column agg_level_desc text
    column location_desc text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column year integer
    column begin_code text
    column end_code text
    column reference_period_desc text
    column week_ending date
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column suppression_code text
    column cv_source text
    column cv_value numeric
    column cv_status text
    column cv_symbol text
    column load_time timestamp without time zone
    column methodology_url text
    column release_expectation text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column slice_key text
    body SELECT fact.observation_sk,
    body     fact.product_id,
    body     release.label AS product_label,
    body     fact.release_watermark,
    body     release.slice_mode,
    body     fact.source_desc,
    body     commodity.sector_desc,
    body     commodity.group_desc,
    body     commodity.commodity_desc,
    body     commodity.class_desc,
    body     commodity.prodn_practice_desc,
    body     commodity.util_practice_desc,
    body     fact.commodity_sk,
    body     statistic.statisticcat_desc,
    body     statistic.short_desc,
    body     statistic.unit_desc,
    body     statistic.freq_desc,
    body     statistic.value_kind,
    body     statistic.calculation_basis,
    body     statistic.additive_behavior,
    body     statistic.additive_behavior_known,
    body     fact.statistic_sk,
    body     domain.domain_desc,
    body     domain.domaincat_desc,
    body     fact.domain_sk,
    body     fact.geo_id,
    body     fact.geo_sk,
    body     fact.geo_type,
    body     fact.geography_status,
    body     fact.geo_source_code,
    body     fact.agg_level_desc,
    body     fact.location_desc,
    body     fact.state_fips,
    body     fact.county_fips,
    body     fact.year,
    body     fact.begin_code,
    body     fact.end_code,
    body     fact.reference_period_desc,
    body     fact.week_ending,
    body     fact.value_source,
    body     fact.value,
    body     fact.value_status,
    body     fact.suppression_code,
    body     fact.cv_source,
    body     fact.cv_value,
    body     fact.cv_status,
    body     fact.cv_symbol,
    body     fact.load_time,
    body     release.methodology_url,
    body     release.release_expectation,
    body     fact.source_record_id,
    body     fact.capture_id,
    body     fact.slice_key
    body    FROM silver_nass.fact_crop_observation fact
    body      JOIN silver_nass.dim_dataset_release release ON release.product_id = fact.product_id AND release.release_watermark = fact.release_watermark
    body      JOIN silver_nass.dim_commodity commodity USING (commodity_sk)
    body      JOIN silver_nass.dim_statistic statistic USING (statistic_sk)
    body      JOIN silver_nass.dim_domain domain USING (domain_sk)
    body   WHERE release.status = 'published'::text AND fact.geography_status <> 'unsupported'::text;

v gold_nass.crop_series
    column series_id text
    column product_id text
    column commodity_sk text
    column statistic_sk text
    column domain_sk text
    column sector_desc text
    column group_desc text
    column commodity_desc text
    column class_desc text
    column prodn_practice_desc text
    column util_practice_desc text
    column statisticcat_desc text
    column short_desc text
    column unit_desc text
    column value_kind text
    column additive_behavior text
    column additive_behavior_known boolean
    column domain_desc text
    column domaincat_desc text
    column geo_id text
    column geo_type text
    column agg_level_desc text
    column freq_desc text
    column source_desc text
    column first_year integer
    column last_year integer
    column observation_count bigint
    column numeric_observation_count bigint
    column non_numeric_observation_count bigint
    column latest_release_watermark text
    body SELECT md5((((((((((product_id || '|'::text) || commodity_sk) || '|'::text) || statistic_sk) || '|'::text) || domain_sk) || '|'::text) || COALESCE(geo_id, geo_source_code)) || '|'::text) || freq_desc) AS series_id,
    body     product_id,
    body     commodity_sk,
    body     statistic_sk,
    body     domain_sk,
    body     sector_desc,
    body     group_desc,
    body     commodity_desc,
    body     class_desc,
    body     prodn_practice_desc,
    body     util_practice_desc,
    body     statisticcat_desc,
    body     short_desc,
    body     unit_desc,
    body     value_kind,
    body     additive_behavior,
    body     additive_behavior_known,
    body     domain_desc,
    body     domaincat_desc,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_type,
    body     agg_level_desc,
    body     freq_desc,
    body     source_desc,
    body     min(year) AS first_year,
    body     max(year) AS last_year,
    body     count(*) AS observation_count,
    body     count(*) FILTER (WHERE value_status = 'valid'::text) AS numeric_observation_count,
    body     count(*) FILTER (WHERE value_status <> 'valid'::text) AS non_numeric_observation_count,
    body     max(release_watermark) AS latest_release_watermark
    body    FROM gold_nass.crop_observation observation
    body   GROUP BY product_id, commodity_sk, statistic_sk, domain_sk, sector_desc, group_desc, commodity_desc, class_desc, prodn_practice_desc, util_practice_desc, statisticcat_desc, short_desc, unit_desc, value_kind, additive_behavior, additive_behavior_known, domain_desc, domaincat_desc, geo_id, geo_source_code, geo_type, agg_level_desc, freq_desc, source_desc;

v gold_nass.latest_release_observation
    column observation_sk bigint
    column product_id text
    column product_label text
    column release_watermark text
    column slice_mode text
    column source_desc text
    column sector_desc text
    column group_desc text
    column commodity_desc text
    column class_desc text
    column prodn_practice_desc text
    column util_practice_desc text
    column commodity_sk text
    column statisticcat_desc text
    column short_desc text
    column unit_desc text
    column freq_desc text
    column value_kind text
    column calculation_basis text
    column additive_behavior text
    column additive_behavior_known boolean
    column statistic_sk text
    column domain_desc text
    column domaincat_desc text
    column domain_sk text
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geography_status text
    column geo_source_code text
    column agg_level_desc text
    column location_desc text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column year integer
    column begin_code text
    column end_code text
    column reference_period_desc text
    column week_ending date
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column suppression_code text
    column cv_source text
    column cv_value numeric
    column cv_status text
    column cv_symbol text
    column load_time timestamp without time zone
    column methodology_url text
    column release_expectation text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column slice_key text
    body SELECT observation.observation_sk,
    body     observation.product_id,
    body     observation.product_label,
    body     observation.release_watermark,
    body     observation.slice_mode,
    body     observation.source_desc,
    body     observation.sector_desc,
    body     observation.group_desc,
    body     observation.commodity_desc,
    body     observation.class_desc,
    body     observation.prodn_practice_desc,
    body     observation.util_practice_desc,
    body     observation.commodity_sk,
    body     observation.statisticcat_desc,
    body     observation.short_desc,
    body     observation.unit_desc,
    body     observation.freq_desc,
    body     observation.value_kind,
    body     observation.calculation_basis,
    body     observation.additive_behavior,
    body     observation.additive_behavior_known,
    body     observation.statistic_sk,
    body     observation.domain_desc,
    body     observation.domaincat_desc,
    body     observation.domain_sk,
    body     observation.geo_id,
    body     observation.geo_sk,
    body     observation.geo_type,
    body     observation.geography_status,
    body     observation.geo_source_code,
    body     observation.agg_level_desc,
    body     observation.location_desc,
    body     observation.state_fips,
    body     observation.county_fips,
    body     observation.year,
    body     observation.begin_code,
    body     observation.end_code,
    body     observation.reference_period_desc,
    body     observation.week_ending,
    body     observation.value_source,
    body     observation.value,
    body     observation.value_status,
    body     observation.suppression_code,
    body     observation.cv_source,
    body     observation.cv_value,
    body     observation.cv_status,
    body     observation.cv_symbol,
    body     observation.load_time,
    body     observation.methodology_url,
    body     observation.release_expectation,
    body     observation.source_record_id,
    body     observation.capture_id,
    body     observation.slice_key
    body    FROM gold_nass.crop_observation observation
    body      JOIN ( SELECT dim_dataset_release.product_id,
    body             max(dim_dataset_release.release_watermark) AS release_watermark
    body            FROM silver_nass.dim_dataset_release
    body           WHERE dim_dataset_release.status = 'published'::text
    body           GROUP BY dim_dataset_release.product_id) latest ON latest.product_id = observation.product_id AND latest.release_watermark = observation.release_watermark;

v gold_nass.measure_export
    column source_dataset text
    column source_measure_code text
    column display_name text
    column statisticcat_desc text
    column unit text
    column freq_desc text
    column value_kind text
    column calculation_basis text
    column additive_behavior text
    column additive_behavior_known boolean
    column source_program text
    column source_watermark text
    column methodology_url text
    column schema_version text
    body SELECT statistic.product_id AS source_dataset,
    body     statistic.statistic_sk AS source_measure_code,
    body     statistic.short_desc AS display_name,
    body     statistic.statisticcat_desc,
    body     statistic.unit_desc AS unit,
    body     statistic.freq_desc,
    body     statistic.value_kind,
    body     statistic.calculation_basis,
    body     statistic.additive_behavior,
    body     statistic.additive_behavior_known,
    body     statistic.source_desc AS source_program,
    body     release.release_watermark AS source_watermark,
    body     release.methodology_url,
    body     release.parser_contract_version AS schema_version
    body    FROM ( SELECT release_1.product_id,
    body             statistic_1.statistic_sk,
    body             statistic_1.short_desc,
    body             statistic_1.statisticcat_desc,
    body             statistic_1.unit_desc,
    body             statistic_1.freq_desc,
    body             statistic_1.value_kind,
    body             statistic_1.calculation_basis,
    body             statistic_1.additive_behavior,
    body             statistic_1.additive_behavior_known,
    body             statistic_1.source_desc
    body            FROM silver_nass.dim_statistic statistic_1
    body              JOIN silver_nass.fact_crop_observation fact ON fact.statistic_sk = statistic_1.statistic_sk
    body              JOIN silver_nass.dim_dataset_release release_1 ON release_1.product_id = fact.product_id AND release_1.release_watermark = fact.release_watermark
    body           WHERE release_1.status = 'published'::text
    body           GROUP BY release_1.product_id, statistic_1.statistic_sk, statistic_1.short_desc, statistic_1.statisticcat_desc, statistic_1.unit_desc, statistic_1.freq_desc, statistic_1.value_kind, statistic_1.calculation_basis, statistic_1.additive_behavior, statistic_1.additive_behavior_known, statistic_1.source_desc) statistic
    body      JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT candidate.product_id,
    body             candidate.release_watermark,
    body             candidate.label,
    body             candidate.source_desc,
    body             candidate.slice_mode,
    body             candidate.methodology_url,
    body             candidate.parser_contract_version,
    body             candidate.incremental_field,
    body             candidate.release_expectation,
    body             candidate.registered_years,
    body             candidate.source_run_id,
    body             candidate.source_record_count,
    body             candidate.quarantine_count,
    body             candidate.slice_count,
    body             candidate.status,
    body             candidate.reconciled_at,
    body             candidate.published_at,
    body             candidate.created_at,
    body             candidate.updated_at
    body            FROM silver_nass.dim_dataset_release candidate
    body           WHERE candidate.product_id = statistic.product_id AND candidate.status = 'published'::text
    body           ORDER BY candidate.release_watermark DESC
    body          LIMIT 1) release ON true;

v gold_nass.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'USDA_NASS'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     (statistic.product_id || ':'::text) || statistic.statistic_sk AS source_object_key,
    body     'statistic'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     statistic.short_desc AS metric_display_name,
    body     statistic.unit_desc AS units,
    body     'source_fact'::text AS measure_kind,
    body     statistic.valid_geo_grains,
    body     statistic.valid_time_grains,
    body     statistic.additive_behavior AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_nass', 'relation', 'crop_observation', 'product_id', statistic.product_id, 'statistic_sk', statistic.statistic_sk, 'statisticcat_desc', statistic.statisticcat_desc, 'unit_desc', statistic.unit_desc) AS physical_lineage,
    body     release.release_watermark AS source_watermark,
    body     release.source_run_id,
    body     release.published_at AS publication_time,
    body     'USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service'::text AS source_name,
    body     'government-agricultural-statistics'::text AS source_type,
    body     release.methodology_url AS reference_url
    body    FROM ( SELECT fact.product_id,
    body             fact.statistic_sk,
    body             statistic_1.short_desc,
    body             statistic_1.unit_desc,
    body             statistic_1.statisticcat_desc,
    body             statistic_1.additive_behavior,
    body             array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(fact.geo_type) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(fact.geo_type))) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body             array_agg(DISTINCT upper(statistic_1.freq_desc) ORDER BY (upper(statistic_1.freq_desc))) AS valid_time_grains
    body            FROM silver_nass.dim_statistic statistic_1
    body              JOIN silver_nass.fact_crop_observation fact ON fact.statistic_sk = statistic_1.statistic_sk
    body              JOIN silver_nass.dim_dataset_release release_1 ON release_1.product_id = fact.product_id AND release_1.release_watermark = fact.release_watermark
    body           WHERE release_1.status = 'published'::text AND fact.geography_status <> 'unsupported'::text
    body           GROUP BY fact.product_id, fact.statistic_sk, statistic_1.short_desc, statistic_1.unit_desc, statistic_1.statisticcat_desc, statistic_1.additive_behavior) statistic
    body      JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT candidate.product_id,
    body             candidate.release_watermark,
    body             candidate.label,
    body             candidate.source_desc,
    body             candidate.slice_mode,
    body             candidate.methodology_url,
    body             candidate.parser_contract_version,
    body             candidate.incremental_field,
    body             candidate.release_expectation,
    body             candidate.registered_years,
    body             candidate.source_run_id,
    body             candidate.source_record_count,
    body             candidate.quarantine_count,
    body             candidate.slice_count,
    body             candidate.status,
    body             candidate.reconciled_at,
    body             candidate.published_at,
    body             candidate.created_at,
    body             candidate.updated_at
    body            FROM silver_nass.dim_dataset_release candidate
    body           WHERE candidate.product_id = statistic.product_id AND candidate.status = 'published'::text
    body           ORDER BY candidate.release_watermark DESC
    body          LIMIT 1) release ON true;

v gold_pep.measure_export
    column source_object_key text
    column metric_display_name text
    column unit text
    column is_component boolean
    column allows_negative boolean
    column population_universe text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column first_period date
    column last_period date
    body SELECT measure.metric_code AS source_object_key,
    body     measure.display_name AS metric_display_name,
    body     measure.unit,
    body     measure.is_component,
    body     measure.allows_negative,
    body     measure.population_universe,
    body     COALESCE(served.valid_geo_grains, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body     max(fact.transformed_at) AS publication_time,
    body     min(fact.estimate_date) AS first_period,
    body     max(fact.estimate_date) AS last_period
    body    FROM silver_pep.dim_measure measure
    body      JOIN silver_pep.fact_population_estimate fact USING (metric_code)
    body      LEFT JOIN ( SELECT revision.metric_code,
    body             array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(revision.geo_type) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(revision.geo_type))) AS valid_geo_grains
    body            FROM gold_pep.population_estimate_revision revision
    body           GROUP BY revision.metric_code) served ON served.metric_code = measure.metric_code
    body   GROUP BY measure.metric_code, served.valid_geo_grains;

v gold_pep.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'CENSUS_PEP'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     source_object_key,
    body     'measure'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     metric_display_name,
    body     unit AS units,
    body         CASE
    body             WHEN is_component THEN 'component'::text
    body             ELSE 'level'::text
    body         END AS measure_kind,
    body     ARRAY( SELECT gold_glossary.geo_grain(value.value) AS geo_grain
    body            FROM unnest(export.valid_geo_grains) value(value)) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY['ANNUAL'::text] AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_pep', 'relation', 'population_estimate_revision', 'key', source_object_key) AS physical_lineage,
    body     publication_time::text AS source_watermark,
    body     NULL::uuid AS source_run_id,
    body     publication_time,
    body     'U.S. Census Bureau Population Estimates Program'::text AS source_name,
    body     'government-statistical-program'::text AS source_type,
    body     'https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/popest.html'::text AS reference_url
    body    FROM gold_pep.measure_export export;

v gold_pep.mv_pep_latest
    column capture_id uuid
    column source_code text
    column observation_date date
    column period text
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone
    column geo_id text
    column geo_level text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column place_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column place_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    column value numeric
    column value_type text
    column units text
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column dataset_code text
    column vintage_year smallint
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column margin_of_error_pct numeric
    body SELECT reporting.capture_id,
    body     reporting.source_code,
    body     reporting.observation_date,
    body     reporting.period,
    body     reporting.duration_start,
    body     reporting.duration_end,
    body     reporting.time_sk,
    body     reporting.as_of_date,
    body     reporting.updated_at,
    body     reporting.geo_id,
    body     reporting.geo_level,
    body     reporting.state_fips,
    body     reporting.county_fips,
    body     reporting.place_fips,
    body     reporting.state_name,
    body     reporting.county_name,
    body     reporting.place_name,
    body     reporting.geo_latitude,
    body     reporting.geo_longitude,
    body     reporting.metric_code,
    body     reporting.metric_display_name,
    body     reporting.value,
    body     reporting.value_type,
    body     reporting.units,
    body     reporting.seasonal_adjustment_status,
    body     reporting.dataset_code,
    body     reporting.vintage_year,
    body     reporting.margin_of_error,
    body     reporting.margin_of_error_pct
    body    FROM gold_pep.rpt_pep_observations reporting
    body      JOIN gold_pep.population_estimate_latest latest ON latest.capture_id = reporting.capture_id AND latest.dataset_code = reporting.dataset_code AND latest.pep_vintage = reporting.vintage_year AND ((('CENSUS_PEP:'::text || latest.dataset_code) || ':'::text) || latest.metric_code) = reporting.metric_code AND latest.geo_id = reporting.geo_id AND latest.observation_year = EXTRACT(year FROM reporting.observation_date)::integer;

v gold_pep.population_change
    column capture_id uuid
    column dataset_code text
    column pep_vintage smallint
    column product_code text
    column metric_code text
    column observation_year smallint
    column estimate_date date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geography_basis_date date
    column summary_level text
    column source_name text
    column functional_status_source text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column unit text
    column source_retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    column is_derived boolean
    body SELECT capture_id,
    body     dataset_code,
    body     pep_vintage,
    body     product_code,
    body     metric_code,
    body     observation_year,
    body     estimate_date,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_sk,
    body     geo_type,
    body     geography_basis_date,
    body     summary_level,
    body     source_name,
    body     functional_status_source,
    body     value_source,
    body     value,
    body     unit,
    body     source_retrieved_at,
    body     false AS is_derived
    body    FROM gold_pep.population_estimate_revision
    body   WHERE metric_code = ANY (ARRAY['NPOPCHG'::text, 'NATURALCHG'::text, 'NETMIG'::text]);

v gold_pep.population_estimate_latest
    column capture_id uuid
    column dataset_code text
    column pep_vintage smallint
    column product_code text
    column metric_code text
    column observation_year smallint
    column estimate_date date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geography_basis_date date
    column summary_level text
    column source_name text
    column functional_status_source text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column unit text
    column source_retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    body SELECT capture_id,
    body     dataset_code,
    body     pep_vintage,
    body     product_code,
    body     metric_code,
    body     observation_year,
    body     estimate_date,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_sk,
    body     geo_type,
    body     geography_basis_date,
    body     summary_level,
    body     source_name,
    body     functional_status_source,
    body     value_source,
    body     value,
    body     unit,
    body     source_retrieved_at
    body    FROM ( SELECT revision.capture_id,
    body             revision.dataset_code,
    body             revision.pep_vintage,
    body             revision.product_code,
    body             revision.metric_code,
    body             revision.observation_year,
    body             revision.estimate_date,
    body             revision.geo_id,
    body             revision.geo_sk,
    body             revision.geo_type,
    body             revision.geography_basis_date,
    body             revision.summary_level,
    body             revision.source_name,
    body             revision.functional_status_source,
    body             revision.value_source,
    body             revision.value,
    body             revision.unit,
    body             revision.source_retrieved_at,
    body             row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY revision.metric_code, revision.geo_id, revision.observation_year ORDER BY (
    body                 CASE
    body                     WHEN dataset.series_kind = 'intercensal'::text THEN 0
    body                     ELSE 1
    body                 END), revision.pep_vintage DESC, (
    body                 CASE
    body                     WHEN revision.summary_level = dataset.native_grain THEN 0
    body                     ELSE 1
    body                 END), revision.dataset_code) AS vintage_rank
    body            FROM gold_pep.population_estimate_revision revision
    body              JOIN silver_pep.pep_dataset dataset ON dataset.dataset_code = revision.dataset_code) ranked
    body   WHERE vintage_rank = 1;

v gold_pep.population_estimate_revision
    column capture_id uuid
    column dataset_code text
    column pep_vintage smallint
    column product_code text
    column metric_code text
    column observation_year smallint
    column estimate_date date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geography_basis_date date
    column summary_level text
    column source_name text
    column functional_status_source text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column unit text
    column source_retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    body WITH ranked AS (
    body          SELECT fact.capture_id,
    body             fact.source_row_index,
    body             fact.source_column_index,
    body             fact.dataset_code,
    body             fact.release_vintage,
    body             fact.product_code,
    body             fact.metric_code,
    body             fact.observation_year,
    body             fact.estimate_date,
    body             fact.geo_id,
    body             fact.geo_sk,
    body             fact.geo_type,
    body             fact.geography_basis_date,
    body             fact.resolution_status,
    body             fact.summary_level,
    body             fact.source_geo_code,
    body             fact.source_name,
    body             fact.functional_status_source,
    body             fact.value_source,
    body             fact.value,
    body             fact.unit,
    body             fact.transformed_at,
    body             capture.retrieved_at AS source_retrieved_at,
    body             row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY fact.dataset_code, fact.release_vintage, fact.metric_code, fact.geo_id, fact.observation_year ORDER BY capture.retrieved_at DESC, fact.capture_id DESC) AS capture_rank
    body            FROM silver_pep.fact_population_estimate fact
    body              JOIN silver_pep.release_load load USING (capture_id)
    body              JOIN raw_capture.response_capture capture USING (capture_id)
    body           WHERE load.completeness_status = 'complete'::text AND fact.resolution_status = 'resolved'::text
    body         )
    body  SELECT capture_id,
    body     dataset_code,
    body     release_vintage AS pep_vintage,
    body     product_code,
    body     metric_code,
    body     observation_year,
    body     estimate_date,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_sk,
    body     geo_type,
    body     geography_basis_date,
    body     summary_level,
    body     source_name,
    body     functional_status_source,
    body     value_source,
    body     value,
    body     unit,
    body     source_retrieved_at
    body    FROM ranked
    body   WHERE capture_rank = 1;

v gold_pep.rpt_pep_observations
    column capture_id uuid
    column source_code text
    column observation_date date
    column period text
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone
    column geo_id text
    column geo_level text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column place_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column place_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    column value numeric
    column value_type text
    column units text
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column dataset_code text
    column vintage_year smallint
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column margin_of_error_pct numeric
    body SELECT revision.capture_id,
    body     'CENSUS_PEP'::text AS source_code,
    body     revision.estimate_date AS observation_date,
    body     revision.estimate_date::text AS period,
    body     revision.estimate_date AS duration_start,
    body     revision.estimate_date AS duration_end,
    body     "time".time_sk,
    body     release.release_date AS as_of_date,
    body     revision.source_retrieved_at AS updated_at,
    body     revision.geo_id,
    body     revision.geo_type AS geo_level,
    body     entity.state_fips,
    body     entity.county_fips,
    body     entity.place_fips,
    body     current.state_name,
    body     current.county_name,
    body     current.place_name,
    body     current.latitude AS geo_latitude,
    body     current.longitude AS geo_longitude,
    body     (('CENSUS_PEP:'::text || revision.dataset_code) || ':'::text) || revision.metric_code AS metric_code,
    body     measure.display_name AS metric_display_name,
    body     revision.value,
    body     measure.value_type,
    body     revision.unit AS units,
    body     NULL::text AS seasonal_adjustment_status,
    body     revision.dataset_code,
    body     revision.pep_vintage AS vintage_year,
    body     NULL::numeric AS margin_of_error,
    body     NULL::numeric AS margin_of_error_pct
    body    FROM gold_pep.population_estimate_revision revision
    body      JOIN silver_pep.dim_measure measure USING (metric_code)
    body      JOIN silver_pep.pep_release release ON release.dataset_code = revision.dataset_code AND release.vintage_year = revision.pep_vintage
    body      JOIN silver_ref.dim_geo_entity entity USING (geo_sk)
    body      LEFT JOIN silver_ref.dim_geo_current current USING (geo_sk)
    body      LEFT JOIN silver_ref.dim_time "time" ON "time".date_key = revision.estimate_date;

r raw_bls.bls_datasets
    column program text NOT NULL
    column year integer NOT NULL
    column title text
    column is_available boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
    column first_seen_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column last_checked_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column last_ingested_at timestamp with time zone
    constraint bls_datasets_pkey PRIMARY KEY (program, year)
    index bls_datasets_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bls_datasets_pkey ON raw_bls.bls_datasets USING btree (program, year)

r raw_bls.bls_series
    column program text NOT NULL
    column series_id text NOT NULL
    column title text
    column seasonal text
    column measure text
    column area_code text
    column area_text text
    column raw_metadata jsonb
    column first_seen_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column last_checked_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint bls_series_pkey PRIMARY KEY (program, series_id)
    index bls_series_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bls_series_pkey ON raw_bls.bls_series USING btree (program, series_id)
    index bls_series_program_idx CREATE INDEX bls_series_program_idx ON raw_bls.bls_series USING btree (program)

r raw_capture.payload_blob
    column payload_checksum text NOT NULL
    column checksum_algorithm text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sha256'::text
    column payload bytea NOT NULL
    column payload_size bigint NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint payload_blob_check CHECK ((payload_size = octet_length(payload)))
    constraint payload_blob_checksum_algorithm_check CHECK ((checksum_algorithm = 'sha256'::text))
    constraint payload_blob_payload_checksum_check CHECK ((payload_checksum ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
    constraint payload_blob_pkey PRIMARY KEY (payload_checksum)
    index payload_blob_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payload_blob_pkey ON raw_capture.payload_blob USING btree (payload_checksum)

r raw_capture.response_capture
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column request_id uuid NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_code text NOT NULL
    column endpoint text NOT NULL
    column request_parameters jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
    column request_fingerprint text NOT NULL
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
    column http_status smallint NOT NULL
    column response_headers jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
    column media_type text NOT NULL
    column payload_schema_version text
    column source_revision text
    column payload_checksum text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint response_capture_capture_id_run_id_source_code_key UNIQUE (capture_id, run_id, source_code)
    constraint response_capture_endpoint_check CHECK ((btrim(endpoint) <> ''::text))
    constraint response_capture_http_status_check CHECK (((http_status >= 100) AND (http_status <= 599)))
    constraint response_capture_media_type_check CHECK ((btrim(media_type) <> ''::text))
    constraint response_capture_payload_checksum_fkey FOREIGN KEY (payload_checksum) REFERENCES raw_capture.payload_blob(payload_checksum)
    constraint response_capture_pkey PRIMARY KEY (capture_id)
    constraint response_capture_request_fingerprint_check CHECK ((request_fingerprint ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
    constraint response_capture_request_id_run_id_source_code_endpoint_re_fkey FOREIGN KEY (request_id, run_id, source_code, endpoint, request_fingerprint) REFERENCES control.ingestion_request(request_id, run_id, source_code, endpoint, request_fingerprint)
    constraint response_capture_source_code_check CHECK ((source_code ~ '^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_-]*$'::text))
    index response_capture_capture_id_run_id_source_code_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX response_capture_capture_id_run_id_source_code_key ON raw_capture.response_capture USING btree (capture_id, run_id, source_code)
    index response_capture_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX response_capture_pkey ON raw_capture.response_capture USING btree (capture_id)
    index response_capture_request_identity_idx CREATE INDEX response_capture_request_identity_idx ON raw_capture.response_capture USING btree (source_code, request_fingerprint, payload_checksum, retrieved_at DESC)
    index response_capture_run_idx CREATE INDEX response_capture_run_idx ON raw_capture.response_capture USING btree (run_id, retrieved_at)

r silver_bls.fact_labor_statistics
    column labor_stat_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('silver_bls.fact_labor_statistics_labor_stat_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column time_sk integer NOT NULL
    column geo_sk bigint NOT NULL
    column duration_start date NOT NULL
    column duration_end date NOT NULL
    column period_date date NOT NULL
    column series_id character varying(255) NOT NULL
    column program character varying(50) NOT NULL
    column geo_level character varying(50)
    column geo_id character varying(255)
    column state_fips character varying(2)
    column county_fips character varying(3)
    column value numeric
    column source_value text
    column value_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'valid'::text
    column year integer NOT NULL
    column period character varying(10) NOT NULL
    column period_name character varying(100)
    column measure_code character varying(10)
    column measure_name text
    column seasonal_adjustment character varying(1) DEFAULT 'U'::character varying
    column source_system character varying(50) DEFAULT 'BLS'::character varying
    column capture_id uuid
    column load_batch_id uuid NOT NULL
    column ingested_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint fact_labor_statistics_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint fact_labor_statistics_geo_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (geo_sk) REFERENCES silver_ref.dim_geo_entity(geo_sk)
    constraint fact_labor_statistics_pkey PRIMARY KEY (labor_stat_sk)
    constraint fact_labor_statistics_published_value_check CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint fact_labor_statistics_time_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (time_sk) REFERENCES silver_ref.dim_time(time_sk)
    constraint fact_labor_statistics_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'missing'::text, 'invalid'::text])))
    constraint fact_labor_stats_uk UNIQUE (series_id, period_date)
    index fact_labor_statistics_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fact_labor_statistics_pkey ON silver_bls.fact_labor_statistics USING btree (labor_stat_sk)
    index fact_labor_stats_uk CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fact_labor_stats_uk ON silver_bls.fact_labor_statistics USING btree (series_id, period_date)
    index idx_fact_labor_geo_sk CREATE INDEX idx_fact_labor_geo_sk ON silver_bls.fact_labor_statistics USING btree (geo_sk)
    index idx_fact_labor_ingested_at CREATE INDEX idx_fact_labor_ingested_at ON silver_bls.fact_labor_statistics USING btree (ingested_at)
    index idx_fact_labor_program CREATE INDEX idx_fact_labor_program ON silver_bls.fact_labor_statistics USING btree (program)
    index idx_fact_labor_series_id CREATE INDEX idx_fact_labor_series_id ON silver_bls.fact_labor_statistics USING btree (series_id)
    index idx_fact_labor_time_sk CREATE INDEX idx_fact_labor_time_sk ON silver_bls.fact_labor_statistics USING btree (time_sk)

r silver_cdc.fact_health_observation
    column observation_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('silver_cdc.fact_health_observation_observation_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column asset_id text NOT NULL

    column source_record_id text NOT NULL

    column value_type_id text NOT NULL
    column stratum_id text NOT NULL

    column period_end integer NOT NULL
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text NOT NULL

    column value_status text NOT NULL

    column confidence_upper numeric

    index cdc_fact_measure_geo_period_idx CREATE INDEX cdc_fact_measure_geo_period_idx ON silver_cdc.fact_health_observation USING btree (asset_id, measure_id, geo_id, period_start, period_end)
    index fact_health_observation_asset_id_release_watermark_source_r_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fact_health_observation_asset_id_release_watermark_source_r_key ON silver_cdc.fact_health_observation USING btree (asset_id, release_watermark, source_record_id)

    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index bigint NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column asset_id text NOT NULL
    column release_watermark text NOT NULL
    column source_record_id text NOT NULL

    column measure_id text NOT NULL
    column measure_label text NOT NULL
    column topic text NOT NULL
    column period_start integer NOT NULL
    column period_end integer NOT NULL
    column geo_source_code text NOT NULL
    column geo_source_label text
    column geo_type text NOT NULL
    column geo_id text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column unit text
    column value_type_id text NOT NULL
    column value_type_label text NOT NULL
    column adjustment_status text NOT NULL
    column confidence_lower numeric
    column confidence_upper numeric
    column footnote_code text
    column footnote_text text
    column stratum_id text NOT NULL
    column strata jsonb NOT NULL
    column estimate_method text NOT NULL
    column population_basis text NOT NULL
    column total_population numeric
    column population_18_plus numeric
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint observation_revision_adjustment_status_check CHECK ((adjustment_status = ANY (ARRAY['crude'::text, 'age_adjusted'::text, 'source_specific'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_asset_id_check CHECK ((asset_id = ANY (ARRAY['cdi'::text, 'places_county'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint observation_revision_check CHECK ((period_end >= period_start))
    constraint observation_revision_check1 CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint observation_revision_check2 CHECK (((confidence_lower IS NULL) OR (confidence_upper IS NULL) OR (confidence_lower <= confidence_upper)))
    constraint observation_revision_geo_type_check CHECK ((geo_type = ANY (ARRAY['nation'::text, 'state'::text, 'county'::text, 'unsupported'::text])))

    constraint observation_revision_stratum_id_check CHECK ((stratum_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
    constraint observation_revision_total_population_check CHECK (((total_population IS NULL) OR (total_population >= (0)::numeric)))
    constraint observation_revision_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'missing'::text, 'suppressed'::text])))

    column county_fips character varying(3)
    column estimate_value numeric
    column source_value text

    constraint fact_demographics_uk UNIQUE (dataset, table_id, variable_code, geo_id, estimate_year)

    index idx_fact_demo_geo_sk CREATE INDEX idx_fact_demo_geo_sk ON silver_census.fact_demographics USING btree (geo_sk)
    index idx_fact_demo_ingested_at CREATE INDEX idx_fact_demo_ingested_at ON silver_census.fact_demographics USING btree (ingested_at)

r silver_fbi.agency_geography_relationship
    column relationship_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('silver_fbi.agency_geography_relationship_relationship_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column ori text NOT NULL
    column relationship_type text NOT NULL
    column source_label text NOT NULL
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column resolution_method text
    column resolution_status text NOT NULL
    column confidence_class text NOT NULL
    column reason_code text
    column effective_start date NOT NULL
    column effective_end date NOT NULL
    column geography_vintage integer NOT NULL
    column evidence_source text NOT NULL
    column evidence_capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column product_id text NOT NULL
    column release_key text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint agency_geography_relationship_check CHECK ((effective_end >= effective_start))
    constraint agency_geography_relationship_check1 CHECK (((resolution_status <> 'resolved'::text) OR (geo_id IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint agency_geography_relationship_check2 CHECK (((resolution_status = 'resolved'::text) OR (geo_sk IS NULL)))
    constraint agency_geography_relationship_confidence_class_check CHECK ((confidence_class = ANY (ARRAY['exact'::text, 'reviewed'::text, 'derived'::text, 'unresolved'::text])))
    constraint agency_geography_relationship_evidence_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (evidence_capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint agency_geography_relationship_geo_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (geo_sk) REFERENCES silver_ref.dim_geo_entity(geo_sk)
    constraint agency_geography_relationship_ori_fkey FOREIGN KEY (ori) REFERENCES silver_fbi.dim_agency(ori)
    constraint agency_geography_relationship_ori_relationship_type_source__key UNIQUE (ori, relationship_type, source_label, geography_vintage, effective_start)
    constraint agency_geography_relationship_pkey PRIMARY KEY (relationship_sk)
    constraint agency_geography_relationship_relationship_type_check CHECK ((relationship_type = ANY (ARRAY['state'::text, 'county'::text, 'place'::text])))
    constraint agency_geography_relationship_resolution_method_check CHECK (((resolution_method IS NULL) OR (resolution_method = ANY (ARRAY['exact_state_code'::text, 'county_label_match'::text, 'reviewed_place_crosswalk'::text]))))
    constraint agency_geography_relationship_resolution_status_check CHECK ((resolution_status = ANY (ARRAY['resolved'::text, 'unresolved'::text, 'ambiguous'::text, 'unsupported'::text])))
    index agency_geography_relationship_ori_relationship_type_source__key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX agency_geography_relationship_ori_relationship_type_source__key ON silver_fbi.agency_geography_relationship USING btree (ori, relationship_type, source_label, geography_vintage, effective_start)
    index agency_geography_relationship_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX agency_geography_relationship_pkey ON silver_fbi.agency_geography_relationship USING btree (relationship_sk)
    index fbi_agency_relationship_geo_idx CREATE INDEX fbi_agency_relationship_geo_idx ON silver_fbi.agency_geography_relationship USING btree (relationship_type, geo_id) WHERE (resolution_status = 'resolved'::text)

r silver_fbi.agency_revision
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index bigint NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column product_id text NOT NULL
    column release_key text NOT NULL
    column ori text NOT NULL
    column agency_name text NOT NULL
    column agency_type text NOT NULL
    column state_code text NOT NULL
    column state_name text
    column county_labels text[] NOT NULL
    column is_nibrs boolean
    column nibrs_start_date text
    column latitude double precision
    column longitude double precision
    column source_record jsonb NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint agency_revision_agency_name_check CHECK ((btrim(agency_name) <> ''::text))
    constraint agency_revision_agency_type_check CHECK ((btrim(agency_type) <> ''::text))
    constraint agency_revision_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint agency_revision_county_labels_check CHECK ((NOT ('NOT SPECIFIED'::text = ANY (county_labels))))
    constraint agency_revision_latitude_check CHECK (((latitude IS NULL) OR ((latitude >= ('-90'::integer)::double precision) AND (latitude <= (90)::double precision))))
    constraint agency_revision_longitude_check CHECK (((longitude IS NULL) OR ((longitude >= ('-180'::integer)::double precision) AND (longitude <= (180)::double precision))))
    constraint agency_revision_ori_check CHECK ((ori ~ '^[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{7}$'::text))
    constraint agency_revision_pkey PRIMARY KEY (capture_id, source_row_index)
    constraint agency_revision_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint agency_revision_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 0))
    constraint agency_revision_state_code_check CHECK ((state_code ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$'::text))
    index agency_revision_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX agency_revision_pkey ON silver_fbi.agency_revision USING btree (capture_id, source_row_index)
    index fbi_agency_revision_run_idx CREATE INDEX fbi_agency_revision_run_idx ON silver_fbi.agency_revision USING btree (run_id, product_id, release_key)

r silver_fbi.dim_agency
    column ori text NOT NULL
    column state_code text NOT NULL
    column geo_sk bigint
    column first_seen_release text NOT NULL
    column last_seen_release text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint dim_agency_geo_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (geo_sk) REFERENCES silver_ref.dim_geo_entity(geo_sk)
    constraint dim_agency_ori_check CHECK ((ori ~ '^[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{7}$'::text))
    constraint dim_agency_pkey PRIMARY KEY (ori)
    constraint dim_agency_state_code_check CHECK ((state_code ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$'::text))
    index dim_agency_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_agency_pkey ON silver_fbi.dim_agency USING btree (ori)

r silver_fbi.fact_crime_observation
    column observation_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('silver_fbi.fact_crime_observation_observation_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column product_id text NOT NULL
    column release_key text NOT NULL
    column source_record_id text NOT NULL
    column measure_id text NOT NULL
    column subject_type text NOT NULL
    column subject_code text NOT NULL
    column subject_label text NOT NULL
    column source_geo_level text NOT NULL
    column period text NOT NULL
    column period_start date NOT NULL
    column period_end date NOT NULL
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geography_status text NOT NULL
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column population_denominator numeric
    column source_run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index bigint NOT NULL
    column transformation_version text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint fact_crime_observation_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint fact_crime_observation_check CHECK (((value_status <> 'reported'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint fact_crime_observation_check1 CHECK (((value_status <> 'not_reported'::text) OR (value IS NULL)))
    constraint fact_crime_observation_geo_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (geo_sk) REFERENCES silver_ref.dim_geo_entity(geo_sk)
    constraint fact_crime_observation_geography_status_check CHECK ((geography_status = ANY (ARRAY['provider_geo_exact'::text, 'agency_only'::text, 'agency_county_bridged'::text, 'agency_place_bridged'::text, 'agency_county_unresolved'::text, 'ambiguous'::text, 'unsupported'::text])))
    constraint fact_crime_observation_pkey PRIMARY KEY (observation_sk)
    constraint fact_crime_observation_product_id_measure_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (product_id, measure_id) REFERENCES silver_fbi.dim_offense_measure(product_id, measure_id)
    constraint fact_crime_observation_product_id_release_key_fkey FOREIGN KEY (product_id, release_key) REFERENCES silver_fbi.dim_ucr_dataset_release(product_id, release_key)
    constraint fact_crime_observation_product_id_release_key_source_record_key UNIQUE (product_id, release_key, source_record_id)
    constraint fact_crime_observation_product_id_release_key_subject_type_fkey FOREIGN KEY (product_id, release_key, subject_type, subject_code, period) REFERENCES silver_fbi.fact_reporting_participation(product_id, release_key, subject_type, subject_code, period)
    constraint fact_crime_observation_source_record_id_check CHECK ((source_record_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
    constraint fact_crime_observation_source_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (source_run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint fact_crime_observation_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['reported'::text, 'not_reported'::text])))
    index fact_crime_observation_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fact_crime_observation_pkey ON silver_fbi.fact_crime_observation USING btree (observation_sk)
    index fact_crime_observation_product_id_release_key_source_record_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fact_crime_observation_product_id_release_key_source_record_key ON silver_fbi.fact_crime_observation USING btree (product_id, release_key, source_record_id)
    index fbi_fact_capture_idx CREATE INDEX fbi_fact_capture_idx ON silver_fbi.fact_crime_observation USING btree (capture_id, source_row_index)
    index fbi_fact_measure_subject_period_idx CREATE INDEX fbi_fact_measure_subject_period_idx ON silver_fbi.fact_crime_observation USING btree (product_id, measure_id, subject_type, subject_code, period)

r silver_fbi.observation_revision
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index bigint NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column product_id text NOT NULL
    column release_key text NOT NULL
    column source_record_id text NOT NULL
    column source_record jsonb NOT NULL
    column ucr_program text NOT NULL
    column offense_code text NOT NULL
    column offense_label text NOT NULL
    column measure_id text NOT NULL
    column measure_form text NOT NULL
    column counted_entity_basis text NOT NULL
    column unit text NOT NULL
    column reported_status text NOT NULL
    column subject_type text NOT NULL
    column subject_code text NOT NULL
    column subject_label text NOT NULL
    column source_geo_level text NOT NULL
    column period text NOT NULL
    column period_start date NOT NULL
    column period_end date NOT NULL
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column population_denominator numeric
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint observation_revision_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint observation_revision_check CHECK ((period_end >= period_start))
    constraint observation_revision_check1 CHECK (((value_status <> 'reported'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint observation_revision_check2 CHECK (((value_status <> 'not_reported'::text) OR (value IS NULL)))
    constraint observation_revision_counted_entity_basis_check CHECK ((counted_entity_basis = ANY (ARRAY['offense'::text, 'clearance'::text, 'arrest'::text, 'incident'::text, 'victim'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_measure_form_check CHECK ((measure_form = ANY (ARRAY['absolute_total'::text, 'rate'::text, 'percentage'::text, 'trend'::text, 'category_count'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_period_check CHECK ((period ~ '^(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-[0-9]{4}$'::text))
    constraint observation_revision_pkey PRIMARY KEY (capture_id, source_row_index)
    constraint observation_revision_population_denominator_check CHECK (((population_denominator IS NULL) OR (population_denominator >= (0)::numeric)))
    constraint observation_revision_reported_status_check CHECK ((reported_status = ANY (ARRAY['reported'::text, 'estimated'::text, 'mixed'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint observation_revision_source_record_id_check CHECK ((source_record_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
    constraint observation_revision_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 0))
    constraint observation_revision_subject_type_check CHECK ((subject_type = ANY (ARRAY['national'::text, 'state'::text, 'agency'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['reported'::text, 'not_reported'::text])))
    index fbi_observation_revision_run_idx CREATE INDEX fbi_observation_revision_run_idx ON silver_fbi.observation_revision USING btree (run_id, product_id, release_key)
    index observation_revision_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX observation_revision_pkey ON silver_fbi.observation_revision USING btree (capture_id, source_row_index)

r silver_fbi.participation_revision
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index bigint NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column product_id text NOT NULL
    column release_key text NOT NULL
    column ucr_program text NOT NULL
    column subject_type text NOT NULL
    column subject_code text NOT NULL
    column subject_label text NOT NULL
    column source_geo_level text NOT NULL
    column period text NOT NULL
    column period_start date NOT NULL
    column period_end date NOT NULL
    column population numeric
    column participated_population numeric
    column coverage_percent numeric
    column coverage_basis text NOT NULL
    column participation_status text NOT NULL
    column source_record jsonb NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint participation_revision_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint participation_revision_check CHECK ((period_end >= period_start))
    constraint participation_revision_check1 CHECK (((population IS NULL) OR (participated_population IS NULL) OR (participated_population <= population)))
    constraint participation_revision_coverage_basis_check CHECK ((coverage_basis = ANY (ARRAY['provider_population_coverage_percent'::text, 'provider_population_only'::text])))
    constraint participation_revision_coverage_percent_check CHECK (((coverage_percent IS NULL) OR ((coverage_percent >= (0)::numeric) AND (coverage_percent <= (100)::numeric))))
    constraint participation_revision_participated_population_check CHECK (((participated_population IS NULL) OR (participated_population >= (0)::numeric)))
    constraint participation_revision_participation_status_check CHECK ((participation_status = ANY (ARRAY['full_participation'::text, 'partial_participation'::text, 'no_participation'::text, 'unknown'::text])))
    constraint participation_revision_period_check CHECK ((period ~ '^(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-[0-9]{4}$'::text))
    constraint participation_revision_pkey PRIMARY KEY (capture_id, source_row_index)
    constraint participation_revision_population_check CHECK (((population IS NULL) OR (population >= (0)::numeric)))
    constraint participation_revision_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint participation_revision_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 0))
    constraint participation_revision_subject_type_check CHECK ((subject_type = ANY (ARRAY['national'::text, 'state'::text, 'agency'::text])))
    index fbi_participation_revision_run_idx CREATE INDEX fbi_participation_revision_run_idx ON silver_fbi.participation_revision USING btree (run_id, product_id, release_key)
    index participation_revision_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX participation_revision_pkey ON silver_fbi.participation_revision USING btree (capture_id, source_row_index)

r silver_fbi.reviewed_place_crosswalk
    column ori text NOT NULL
    column place_geo_id text NOT NULL
    column place_name text NOT NULL
    column state_fips text NOT NULL
    column place_fips text NOT NULL
    column geography_vintage integer NOT NULL
    column effective_start date NOT NULL
    column effective_end date
    column crosswalk_version text NOT NULL
    column evidence_url text NOT NULL
    column review_note text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint reviewed_place_crosswalk_check CHECK (((effective_end IS NULL) OR (effective_end >= effective_start)))
    constraint reviewed_place_crosswalk_check1 CHECK ((place_geo_id = ((('state:'::text || state_fips) || '|place:'::text) || place_fips)))
    constraint reviewed_place_crosswalk_ori_check CHECK ((ori ~ '^[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{7}$'::text))
    constraint reviewed_place_crosswalk_pkey PRIMARY KEY (ori, place_geo_id, effective_start)
    constraint reviewed_place_crosswalk_place_fips_check CHECK ((place_fips ~ '^[0-9]{5}$'::text))
    constraint reviewed_place_crosswalk_state_fips_check CHECK ((state_fips ~ '^[0-9]{2}$'::text))
    index reviewed_place_crosswalk_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX reviewed_place_crosswalk_pkey ON silver_fbi.reviewed_place_crosswalk USING btree (ori, place_geo_id, effective_start)

    index fact_economic_indicators_uk CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fact_economic_indicators_uk ON silver_fred.fact_economic_indicators USING btree (series_id, observation_date)

    index idx_fact_econ_ingested_at CREATE INDEX idx_fact_econ_ingested_at ON silver_fred.fact_economic_indicators USING btree (ingested_at)
    index idx_fact_econ_series_id CREATE INDEX idx_fact_econ_series_id ON silver_fred.fact_economic_indicators USING btree (series_id)

    column reconciled_at timestamp with time zone
    column published_at timestamp with time zone
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint dim_dataset_release_check CHECK (((status = 'replaying'::text) OR (reconciled_at IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint dim_dataset_release_check1 CHECK (((status <> 'published'::text) OR (published_at IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint dim_dataset_release_pkey PRIMARY KEY (product_id, release_watermark)
    constraint dim_dataset_release_quarantine_count_check CHECK ((quarantine_count >= 0))
    constraint dim_dataset_release_release_watermark_check CHECK ((btrim(release_watermark) <> ''::text))
    constraint dim_dataset_release_slice_count_check CHECK ((slice_count >= 0))
    constraint dim_dataset_release_slice_mode_check CHECK ((slice_mode = ANY (ARRAY['recent'::text, 'full'::text])))
    constraint dim_dataset_release_source_desc_check CHECK ((source_desc = ANY (ARRAY['SURVEY'::text, 'CENSUS'::text])))
    constraint dim_dataset_release_source_record_count_check CHECK ((source_record_count >= 0))
    constraint dim_dataset_release_source_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (source_run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint dim_dataset_release_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['replaying'::text, 'silver_ready'::text, 'published'::text])))
    index dim_dataset_release_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_dataset_release_pkey ON silver_nass.dim_dataset_release USING btree (product_id, release_watermark)

    column source_row_index bigint NOT NULL
    column slice_key text NOT NULL
    column commodity_sk text NOT NULL
    column statistic_sk text NOT NULL
    column domain_sk text NOT NULL

    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text NOT NULL
    column geography_status text NOT NULL
    column geo_source_code text NOT NULL
    column agg_level_desc text NOT NULL
    column location_desc text NOT NULL
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text

    column freq_desc text NOT NULL
    column begin_code text NOT NULL
    column end_code text NOT NULL

    column week_ending date

    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column suppression_code text
    column unit_desc text NOT NULL

    column cv_value numeric
    column cv_status text NOT NULL
    column cv_symbol text
    column load_time timestamp without time zone
    column source_desc text NOT NULL
    column transformation_version text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint fact_crop_observation_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint fact_crop_observation_check CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint fact_crop_observation_check1 CHECK (((value_status = 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NULL)))
    constraint fact_crop_observation_check2 CHECK (((cv_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (cv_value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint fact_crop_observation_check3 CHECK (((cv_status = 'valid'::text) OR (cv_value IS NULL)))
    constraint fact_crop_observation_check4 CHECK (((geo_type = 'unsupported'::text) = (geo_id IS NULL)))
    constraint fact_crop_observation_commodity_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (commodity_sk) REFERENCES silver_nass.dim_commodity(commodity_sk)

    constraint fact_crop_observation_geography_status_check CHECK ((geography_status = ANY (ARRAY['resolved'::text, 'unmapped'::text, 'unsupported'::text])))
    constraint fact_crop_observation_pkey PRIMARY KEY (observation_sk)
    constraint fact_crop_observation_product_id_release_watermark_fkey FOREIGN KEY (product_id, release_watermark) REFERENCES silver_nass.dim_dataset_release(product_id, release_watermark)
    constraint fact_crop_observation_product_id_release_watermark_source_r_key UNIQUE (product_id, release_watermark, source_record_id)
    constraint fact_crop_observation_source_desc_check CHECK ((source_desc = ANY (ARRAY['SURVEY'::text, 'CENSUS'::text])))
    constraint fact_crop_observation_source_record_id_check CHECK ((source_record_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
    constraint fact_crop_observation_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 0))
    constraint fact_crop_observation_source_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (source_run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint fact_crop_observation_statistic_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (statistic_sk) REFERENCES silver_nass.dim_statistic(statistic_sk)
    constraint fact_crop_observation_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'missing'::text, 'withheld'::text, 'insufficient_reports'::text, 'not_applicable'::text, 'not_available'::text, 'below_rounding_unit'::text, 'quality_flagged'::text])))
    constraint fact_crop_observation_year_check CHECK (((year >= 1800) AND (year <= 2200)))
    index fact_crop_observation_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fact_crop_observation_pkey ON silver_nass.fact_crop_observation USING btree (observation_sk)
    index fact_crop_observation_product_id_release_watermark_source_r_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fact_crop_observation_product_id_release_watermark_source_r_key ON silver_nass.fact_crop_observation USING btree (product_id, release_watermark, source_record_id)
    index usda_nass_fact_capture_idx CREATE INDEX usda_nass_fact_capture_idx ON silver_nass.fact_crop_observation USING btree (capture_id, source_row_index)
